title: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
overview: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

overview: Ana is a dedicated housekeeper, considered "part of the family". When her employer demands cod for an important dinner, and there is none at home, the desperate search for the ingredient turns into anxiety, pushing Ana to her breaking point.

title: Devils Lake
overview: When a group of kids go to the small town of Devils Lake for a bible camp, they are soon thrust into a cosmic reality of paranoia and terror following the mysterious death of their camp counselor.

title: The Time Machine: A UTS Revue
overview: Aspiring directors, Cam and Felicity, pitch a revue that gets rejected immediately. In order to put on the show they've always dreamt about, they hatch a plan. But what happens when that plan goes wrong?

title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
overview: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

title: Transition
overview: Renowned documentarian Thomas Heise begins a film on Berlin's Schönhauser Allee, the road he lived on for decades. A few months later, Heise dies unexpectedly.

title: The Bench
overview: All Risto wants is a peaceful burial for his mother - but family is family.

title: Большой друг
overview: Vova and Misha are participants in a charity project where any adult can become a mentor for a child from an orphanage. They've been friends for over six months and have a great time together. Vova teaches Misha to drive and is concerned about his college admissions. Everything changes when Misha gets another mentor – Irina, a woman who wants to adopt him.

title: Middle Class
overview: Set in a former train factory turned art gallery in Milan, Italy, Classe Media explores the contradictions of being a working class artist. This documentary short follows the filmmaker as they question their class position as an unemployed artist in residence in this former working class space.

title: Baggage Claim
overview: Upon learning of their mother's untimely death, lone-stoner Abby and type-A brother Ben must embark on a body identification road trip home to claim her corpse - along with their own personal baggage.

title: AGAIN
overview: After having her proverbial third eye opened by the strange man who calls himself The Great Opticisioner, Evie Narmer is able to see directly into her past lives. Proving two things: reincarnation is real, but also that her past lives were awful. One of them in particular depicts an awful cult that she thus writes a deep and detailed novel on. Unexpectedly, the last surviving original member catches wind of this novel, and reignites the flame that cult once had. Now, that old man and Evie are at odds. What will happen next? Watch and find out.

title: Field Mouse
overview: There's a mouse trapped in Leonard's house. It's stuck in the walls of the basement.

title: Later.
overview: The invisible half of his brother's rap act, a 17-year-old beatmaker spends the night of the biggest show running errands. He steals an hour for his own music and gets caught for the one thing he did for himself.

title: No Contact
overview: Nostalgia, Black Eyed Peas, and the unwritten rules of New York City dating. When two strangers meet on a bench, a 21-day "break" turns into a masterclass on romance, airport running tropes, West Side Highway running etiquette, and what it actually takes to win someone back.

title: The Wandering Creature (And Other Tales)
overview: Writer/director Christopher R. Mihm takes a stab (pun intended) at an anthology movie in the vein of "Twilight Zone: The Movie," "Trilogy of Terror," and "Creepshow," albeit in his signature retro-B-movie style! In a series of linked, short tales-of-horror, an unmanned spacecraft returning from the asteroid Vesta breaks up upon re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere and scatters sample containers across Phantom Lake County! Not-so-unexpectedly, contact with the mysterious, otherworldly contents of these canisters creates a whole host of terrifying creatures—like mushroom monsters, killer garden gnomes, and more!

title: LILITH
overview: SHE LEFT ONE MORNING AND NEVER ARRIVED—NOW SOMETHING’S HOME, AND IT ISN’T ALIVE.

title: Niu Lai
overview: The naive calf Niu Lai loves exploring the grasslands, but struggles to live up to his family’s expectations as future leader of the herd. With migration fast approaching, Niu Lai finds unlikely allies on his journey to learn the meaning of courage as they prepare for a dangerous trek across the desert.

title: Rodeo
overview: Two men meet one night to engage in a radical and mysterious act of intimacy.

title: The Painting
overview: A young woman lives alone in a cabin and in the middle of the woods she's used to being alone, but slowly she realizes she is being watched.

title: The Tinderbox Against the Magic Well
overview: Based on a story by H.C. Andersen, with new magical heroes, terrifying “woodpunk” robot dogs, real puppet theater, songs & dance numbers. Little Hans, a kind itinerant storyteller, opens his magic box, takes out his puppets, and, together with his spectators, creates a new fairytale. But not every character obeys the puppet master’s strings. The truth of the fairytale breaks everyday rules: here loyalty and friendship make miracles; love destroys the strongest magic spells; and a song wins a war!

title: Super Troopers 3
overview: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

title: Greta e le favole vere
overview: Nine-year-old Greta loves making Christmas decorations with her babysitter, Katy. She believes so strongly in Santa Claus that she decides to deliver a letter to her neighbor, Nicola, who leads her to believe he is Santa's personal assistant. Of course, Nicola has been lying; when Greta exposes the truth, he confesses that he has no connection to Santa Claus. To make amends, Nicola—a talented illustrator—draws an animated fairy tale for her that will change her life.

title: Feed
overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

title: Young Washington
overview: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

title: Rage of Stars
overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

title: Flieg steil
overview: Konnie, a respected musician in the right-wing scene, loses her reputation when she incorporates feminist and queer content into her music. In order to rehabilitate herself, she uses the outsider punk Rudi, who wants to attack a Nazi pub. But both end up fighting a battle for belonging - who will be left standing?

title: KikoRiki: Through the Universes
overview: Krosh and the Hedgehog find an unusual device in Chamomile Valley that takes them into a game about the future, where they are ordinary children on a spaceship flying to Mars. Adventures begin when the characters realize that this is not a game at all.

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: Sweet Milk Lake
overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: Ice Cream Man
overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

title: The Belt
overview: A young woman's night unravels into chaos after she accidentally locks herself into a chastity belt during a house party and loses the key.

title: Hotel Falcon's Glow
overview: After losing her heroic husband, Oksana, the owner of a small hotel, strives to preserve his memory and her own dream. She is supported by Roman, a war veteran who finds a new calling in peaceful life. Together, they stand up to a powerful competitor who is trying to destroy their business.

title: MAJU (Jejak Pahit si Kembang Gula)
overview: Mr. Wira is a teacher and scout leader for a group of his students. They plan to survey the location of the Scout Jamboree in Segosari village. Bagas, a big fan of the popular candy variety at that time, did not join his teacher and friends to visit the Village Head's house. Bagas was feeling unwell and just waited in the car. Upon returning from the Village Head's house, Bagas disappeared. The presence of Adit, a village boy who often gets bullied by other children, becomes an important key to finding Bagas.

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: Playback
overview: PLAYBACK is not just a biopic about Carlos Paião. It's a journey into the creative universe of one of the greatest geniuses of Portuguese music. Carlos studies Medicine, lives among books, exams, and expectations, but it is in the secret of melodies, words, and imagination that he finds the place where he truly breathes. In a country still discovering new sounds, he risks exchanging the security of a white coat for the uncertainty of stages, songs, and a dream bigger than himself. Between duty and desire, reason and intuition, fear and courage, Carlos builds a unique path, made of talent, humor, creative obsession, and an almost luminous urgency to leave his mark. PLAYBACK reveals not only the songs that made Carlos Paião an unforgettable figure in Portuguese music, but also the intimate universe from which they were born.

title: Rehmat
overview: A woman secretly shelters a wounded stranger in her home, while his family endures the weight of grief and impossible choices. Meanwhile, a mysterious elderly man arrives in a village, calling himself God.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Milk
overview: After Charel kills his mother's favorite fish, he runs away from home.

title: 6 grams
overview: Four fathers meet in the secondary school gym, where the headmistress has summoned them after a bag containing a suspicious white powder was found amongst their sons’ belongings during a skiing trip. Each of them arrives with different excuses and the conviction that it is their child who is innocent. What’s more, the headmistress knows that a local councillor is trying to secure her job for his mistress, and she suspects that the whole situation is part of a campaign against her. The meeting thus quickly descends into a series of misunderstandings, accusations and increasingly absurd situations. One afternoon that spirals completely out of control for everyone involved.

title: How to Survive a Marriage
overview: Maryana is a successful divorce lawyer, but her own marriage to Dima is far from ideal. On her birthday, her mother, the eccentric provincial actress Margarita, unexpectedly arrives. In an attempt to stay and bond with her daughter, Margarita claims Dima has an affair.

title: DCI 2026: Big, Loud and Live
overview: Experience the thunderous power and precision of the world’s finest marching music ensembles. “Big, Loud & Live” brings the 2026 Drum Corps International World Championship Prelims to the big screen, broadcast live from Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Beyond your average halftime show, the talented ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League blend world-class musicianship with breathtaking choreography and spellbinding visual formations. You’ll have the best seat in the house to witness the top 15 drum corps go head-to-head competing for their shot at the 2026 DCI World Championship title. From the earth-shaking roar of the brass to the lightning-fast precision of the percussion and color guard, see and hear every detail in stunning high definition. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or looking for a one-of-a-kind, live musical event, this is the ultimate way to experience the pinnacle of the marching arts.

title: Hill 338
overview: New comedy film inspired by the Israeli classic "Halfon Hill Doesn't Answer", released to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Somewhere in the Great Rift Valley stands a small, forgotten, and seemingly useless military base. When the Chinese government offers the state of Israel an enormous sum of cash to lay the path of their new Silk Road through it, all that seems to be done is to shut this base down. Ran Shem Tov, a "disassembly officer" who was deployed to command due to "military streamlining needs", is recruited for this mission. But the thing Ran and the heads of the IDF don't know is that an old bunker was built beneath the base, for which no one remembers the cause of construction. Lately, strange things have been happening in it, which delay the base's shutdown. These events bring all soldiers together against internal and external forces.

title: Tiket Sehala
overview: Alif, Putri and Taqy, three Malaysians trapped in a human trafficking syndicate in South Korea, show the dark reality of labor exploitation and the struggle to return home.

title: Gauthali
overview: Child bride Gauthali overcomes abuse, loss, and discrimination through the power of education. Her determination to reclaim her future challenges deep-rooted traditions inspiring to stand against gender inequality.

title: Under The Impression You Are Flying
overview: A girl traverses landscapes that change without logic, following an inner voice that accompanies, seduces, and confuses her. Between empty beaches, off-axis skies, and faceless presences, reality slowly dissolves into a hypnotic flow of temporal voids, euphoria, and anxiety.

title: CatVideoFest 2026
overview: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Each year, CatVideoFest curates a compilation reel of the latest, best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and, of course, classic internet powerhouses (Keyboard Cat, we’re looking at you).

title: National Seating
overview: Pleas Everson Sr. waxes poetically about his history of employment.

title: Potato Salad
overview: On Christmas Eve, a detective receives a call about a suicide that occurred during a dinner. When he arrives at the scene, he quickly realizes that something isn’t right and what appears to be a suicide may actually be something far more sinister.

title: Watch Out for the Ghosts
overview: A personal meditation on loss, family, home and reclamation through the artistic process of Adebunmi Gbadebo. Gbadebo creates works out of organic materials from the South Carolina plantation cemeteries where her formerly enslaved ancestors and their descendants are buried.

title: White Musk
overview: Tensions arise when a young Sudanese woman becomes her mother's primary caregiver.

title: When They're Gone
overview: After an abrupt encounter at a graveyard, two elderly men form an unexpected bond over the grief and love of their late wives.

title: To Run Is To Return
overview: A young Black British man drives his car through a London landscape with skill as his music blares. His old lanyard that exposes his profession as a pharmacist dangles on the rearview mirror, bouncing to the beat of his music. He is willing it to be a good day. But as he approaches his destination, the cracks begin to show.

title: Ish Meets a Mermaid
overview: An artist in a slump meets a mysterious woman from a realm beneath Lake Superior and finds success in the last place he ever expected -- death.

title: For Peace of Mind
overview: In a world shaped before her time, Kya is learning softer, slower, freer ways to exist. When her mother, Gigi, unexpectedly arrives, she brings with her the generational discord Kya has been quietly working through. Rather than resist her mother’s presence, Kya learns to move with it. She seeks refuge in healing rituals with a circle of women she trusts, guided by a powerful healer named Martha, whose ancient medicine, Rapé, loosens something long buried in Kya and begins to soothe her generational wound. Through tears and sacred smoke and the roar of the ocean, her journey is revealed. And she finds the courage to hold her mother’s story, her grandmother’s story and her great-grandmother’s story with tenderness.

title: Fists of Mothers
overview: An action film about what happens when two mothers have an awkward conversation about a playdate that turns violent. A fun ride about Black maternal rage, a release for what we’re unable to do in real life — be angry, be messy in the face of both spectacular violence enacted on us and our families as well as the micro-aggressions that have a hidden violence that cuts deep.

title: Voicemail
overview: Set within a bright, colorful surreal dream eventually-turn-nightmare, the artist responds to voicemail messages from his late mother.

title: Glass Bricks
overview: Finessa Jawn — a trained dancer and life-long performer — gives us a look behind the curtain into the world of drag, walking us through the process of building a persona and embracing who you are regardless of society's expectations.

title: Authors of the Estate
overview: In North West London, two estates take their story into their own hands, asking what if a council house can become a publishing house in this tale of ownership, creativity, and the power of community.

title: Angels Pull Your Hair
overview: Angels Pull Your Hair is a narrative short about Danielle, a young Black woman grappling with the lasting impact of being raised by a mother with untreated mental illness. As Danielle struggles to make sense of her past, she’s haunted by the fear that she’s inherited her mother’s condition — a fear that takes form in the figure of a faceless sleep paralysis demon

title: Finding Your Laughter
overview: Comedian Arlieta Hall turns to improv as a tool to caregive for her father Milton, who is losing himself to Alzheimer’s.

title: The Seeds We Carry
overview: The Seeds We Carry is a short documentary weaving intimate portraits of community farm stewards in Southwest Philadelphia. Through the rhythms of planting, cooking, and sharing food, the protagonists reveal how everyday acts of care and resistance nurture belonging, forge cross-cultural kinship, and preserve a sense of home amid the pressures of displacement in a rapidly changing city.

title: Old Man River
overview: Old Man River continues Iyabo Kwayana’s exploration of lineage, memory and inheritance through an intimate portrait of her father, a 100-year-old political activist and nation builder from Guyana who helped found the country’s first multiethnic political party. The film sits beside him as he reflects on a lifetime shaped by political struggle, idealism, sacrifice and the contradictions within revolutionary movements.

title: Our Bodies Ours
overview: A short poetic animated film that explores the nuance and beauty of trans becoming from a diasporic lens.

title: The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines
overview: For decades, Philadelphia music educator Lovett Hines quietly shaped generations of artists from behind the scenes, nurturing creativity, discipline, individuality and community through music education. Now at 80 years old, his influence continues to ripple across stages, classrooms and cultures through the students and mentees whose lives he helped transform.  Blending intimate conversation, performance, archival elements and reflections from acclaimed artists including Christian McBride, Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, Bilal and Robert Glasper, The Philadelphia Sensei: Lovett Hines explores the enduring impact of a Black mentor whose classroom became a launching ground for artistic excellence, self-discovery and cultural legacy.  At its heart, the film is a meditation on mentorship, lineage and the often unseen architects behind transformative art.

title: West Side Familia
overview: Through intimate portraits of this tight-knit community, West Side Familia follows the story of a Puerto Rican-led biker gang and community care group from the ‘70s grappling with the preservation of their public traditions and cultural identity in the hyper-gentrified neighborhood of Manhattan’s Upper West Side.

title: 66 Days
overview: Set in the village of Bazouriye in South Lebanon, "66 Days" follows filmmaker Joude Bazzoun’s return to her homeland after witnessing Israel’s 2024 assault on Lebanon from abroad. Through intimate conversations with her family, Joude uncovers the losses they have suffered as a result of the war. The film reflects on the importance of memory and tradition by exploring the ritual of a card game and family gatherings. 66 days quietly resists erasure, preserving the family’s stories and heritage while celebrating the defiant joy found in simple family traditions.

title: Enjoy the tropix and have a banana !
overview: Screenshots of the reality of an islander who enjoys having at the expense of being — like a twist of fate, as if trapped in a hamster wheel, where our slightest desire has to be satisfied now, perhaps in the hope of compensating for all the days without. Welcome to “the Tropics”! Where the paradoxes of neocolonial daily life are at work in a suffocating economic and health context.

title: Solace
overview: Framed by a speech given by the filmmaker’s brother at their uncle’s memorial service, this doc/fiction hybrid comedy blends archival family photos with surreal animated scripted scenes to explore outsized childhood fears, shifting family dynamics and intergenerational care.

title: Zenón and the Rebel Boats
overview: After being displaced from his home by the U.S. Navy to build a military base, Puerto Rican fisherman Carlos “Taso” Zenón pledged his life to fight against the military occupation of the island of Vieques. Alongside Puerto Rican fishermen and activists, Zenón organized countless efforts to halt U.S. war games in the Caribbean Sea. Never-before-seen archival footage reveals the artisanal strategies implemented by fearless fishermen to defy warships, inspiring one of the most influential environmental and anti-war movements in the Caribbean.

title: Zombies on The Beach
overview: A normal beach trip turned into a disaster.

title: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. ATINY has vanished… As if under a spell, ATEEZ wanders through a dreamlike wasteland, into a collapsing world engulfed in flames, and the Dark City veiled in dense fog. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY.

title: Still Standing, Still Stuffed
overview: Once beloved TV puppet stars from the golden age of children’s television have long been forgotten. Decades later, they struggle to survive in the absurd realities of the modern world. When they reunite, the old friends set out on an impossible mission — to stage a comeback.  Blending sharp satire with warm nostalgia and pulsing with 80s synthwave vibes, this wild, heartfelt comedy explores aging icons, lost dreams, and the hilarious quest to stay relevant in a world that has moved on.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 12
overview: The twelfth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 6, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Yota Tsuji and Boltin Oleg.

title: First Fire
overview: Clara gives birth to her first child. In the chaos of postpartum, she tries to get her life back on track.

title: The Bovine Comedy
overview: In a future where cows have nearly vanished, Phop, a rich farmer, owns Southeast Asia's last bull.

title: Dry Wood
overview: 96-year-old clarinet master Grigoris Kapsalis, the last living musician of a generation that shaped the music of Epirus, has long been an integral part of the local village feast. In this final encounter at his home, he offers glimpses into a lifetime devoted to music; meanwhile, preparations for the annual feast begin in the village square.

title: Ohh My Dog
overview: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: You Don't Belong Here
overview: Marius is the chief medical officer at a hospital in his small hometown, raising a teenage son, Ioan, alone after the death of his wife. He is a confident professional, who has no idea what his son gets up to at night.

title: Manhunt
overview: Inspired by the real 2019 Northern British Columbia manhunt when two teenage boys from Vancouver Island murdered three strangers and fled north through ghost towns and endless forest. Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

title: Storm Bird
overview: A celebrated composer facing death, his working-class neighbour facing jail, and a sharp New York writer form an unlikely alliance over one charged weekend in Far North Queensland.

title: Small Talk
overview: Hoping to launch a career in the luxury world, Charlie enrolls at the last finishing school in Switzerland. Over the course of a summer, women from around the world learn the codes of elegance, etiquette and conversation meant to prepare them for elite social circles. As they refine their gestures and manners, a world of aspiration, discipline and self-transformation gradually unfolds.

title: Armony
overview: Armony, a 55-year-old solitary truck driver, finds himself taking responsibility for his six-year-old niece Carlotta after the disappearance of his sister. By his side are Pamela, an elderly transgender woman, and Jenny, a neighbor who is expecting a baby. When social services threaten to take the child away, Armony is forced to fight with all his strength to obtain legal guardianship.

title: Happiness Is So Close!
overview: 80-year-old Jean-Luc is set to play Don Quixote. It's the role he's been waiting for to bid farewell to the stage. Given his health concerns, the production team hires an understudy. Jean-Luc becomes convinced that the understudy is trying to take his place.

title: The Angel Maker
overview: Tells the story of the Swiss religious community of Methernitha, which still exists today, its founder Paul Baumann – the inventor of a mysterious energy machine – and the young women who brought him down on charges of child abuse.

title: Changes: The Story Of Sugar
overview: The rise and fall and reunion of punk rock icon Bob Mould's 1990s post-Hüsker Dü band Sugar.

title: Крайний мёд
overview: Without education or experience, acting intuitively, local residents in Yakutia are beginning to develop beekeeping. They are the world's northernmost beekeepers, cautiously checking their apiaries all summer long, delighted by the buzzing of bees. By autumn, these people have formed a beekeepers' association and are beginning to extract their first honey.

title: Случилась жизнь: Однажды в театре Эстрады
overview: The amazing story of the musical "Boston Waltz," based on the hits of Alexander Rosenbaum. Behind "Boston Waltz," the musical is a vast creative undertaking, in which every scene, every rehearsal, and every decision recreates a plot woven from the meanings of Alexander Yakovlevich Rosenbaum's songs. A film about the making of the production shows how a powerful, emotional, and truly vibrant theatrical event emerges from thousands of individual fragments, resonating with audiences.

title: Cannelloni
overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

title: Red Lady With Two Guns
overview: On her wedding day in 1938, Gao Shengnan saw her husband brutally murdered by the Japanese army and her elders slaughtered. Taking up arms to rally a resistance force, she struck repeatedly at the invaders, earning widespread renown; later, guided by the Eighth Route Army, she resolved to join the revolution. When the Japanese attempted to lure her into a trap, she faced the enemy alone, risking her life to ensure the safety of her fellow villagers. At the critical moment, the Eighth Route Army launched a surprise attack and wiped out the enemy, but Gao Shengnan lay bloodied on the battlefield—her fate hanging in the balance...

title: 10th 'B'
overview: Two best friends from Class 10-B reunite at their old school after years apart. As they revisit bittersweet memories and reflect on the reasons they lost touch, they begin to rediscover the bond they once shared.

title: ORPHIA
overview: A band defined by fame and excess reunites for a landmark concert. As old wounds resurface, Ravi, Ícaro, Anastasia, Theo, and Eva are forced to confront the consequences of their choices, the weight of guilt, and the boundaries between affection, dependency, and redemption. Amidst the chaos, music remains the only place where it is still possible to exist.

title: Support
overview: A mismatched group of strangers meet in a support group, but as their vices fade, their chaotic bond grows

title: Sofiane Saidi, Camelia Jordana & Théo Ceccaldi - Jazz à Porquerolles 2026
Iron Farm
overview: Police officers Rahim(Irfan Zaini) and Easwaran(Logavarman) begin investigating the disappearance of 15-year-old student in the town of Sri Tebong. As the investigation unfolds, they uncover hidden secrets, unexpected connections, and dark truths buried within the community and the mysteries hidden behind ordinary lives.

title: The Encounter
overview: After a young man comes into contact with something otherworldly, two investigators are sent to uncover what happened.

title: Vietslam: Squashing the Cultural Gap
overview: This documentary follows the birth of Vietnam's indie professional wrestling scene- from cramped gyms to a breakout showcase- capturing the hustle, humor, and heart it takes to win over skeptics and build a community one suplex at a time.

title: Love is Love
overview: Enrique Juarez is an up-and-coming Mexican Telenovela actor on the verge of becoming a leading man, that has to hide his true self in order to achieve stardom.

title: A Social Contract
overview: A Fourth of July dinner turns deadly when a nuclear strike is announced. A helicopter is coming for Senator Wilde—but only three others can join him. Guests fight to prove who deserves a seat before time runs out.

title: The Invisible Guest
overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

title: The Days Off
overview: In the near future, during a relentless summer break and with a solar eclipse approaching, 12-year-old Bego struggles to find her place within her family and among girls her age.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: Beast Race
overview: Inspired by the illegal universe of the Brazilian animal lottery, a fearless young man must win a deadly race to save his sister in a dystopian future where each animal in the game is now represented by a runner vying for a prize.

title: The Last House
overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

title: For Sale By Exorcist
overview: Susan Price is a savvy realtor and certified exorcist who’s spent years flipping haunted houses across the country. From bleeding walls to glowing eyes, every listing is to die for! But as Susan hunts for her own forever home, the ghosts she’s evicted return for revenge. Will Susan settle with these vengeful spirits…or could she lose her life along with her down payment?

title: 4 Kids Walk Into a Bank
overview: After losing her mother, Paige's grandfather steps into to become a more responsible guardian. But when a group of criminals show up at their door demanding that Paige's grandpa join them for one last job, she's faced with a decision: let her newly reformed grandpa dip back into his criminal ways, or enlist her three best friends to do the job first.

title: Wei Baba
overview: A woman introduces her Chinese dad to her American Jewish boyfriend and manipulates their language barrier to keep everyone happy.

title: Becoming
overview: In Almaty, Kazakhstan, 17-year-old Mila escapes her unstable home life by joining an elite swimming team led by Vlad. Amid intense training and suspicions of doping, Mila faces a complex attraction to Vlad, while traumatic memories and moral dilemmas threaten to undermine her new-found independence.

title: The Absent
overview: The first work written and directed by Xinjiang female director Lu Dan uses a delicate technique to tell the story of a Russian photographer who has been away from his hometown for a long time, a Han girl who wanders around looking for her father, and a lonely Tatar accordionist in a northern town in winter. A story of unexpected encounters.

title: KJQ
overview: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

title: Dark Thoughts
overview: A young family moves to the countryside to escape creditors. But in the village home of their deceased aunt, an evil more dangerous than any debt collector awaits them.

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
overview: Gianina, a young Romanian, works as a housekeeper for a bourgeois family in Bordeaux. In the evenings, she rehearses the role of a maid with an amateur theater troupe in an adaptation of The Diary of a Chambermaid by Octave Mirbeau. She takes care of Louen, her employers’ son, while her own daughter is growing up far from her, in Romania. The maternal absence deepens into a wound but, as Christmas approaches, the promise of a reunion begins to take shape.

title: Atonement
overview: Based on Dexter Filkins’ resonant New Yorker article of the same name, about Marine Lu Lobello, haunted by memories of a deadly incident in Baghdad, whose journey of guilt and remorse leads him to reach out to Nora, the sole surviving member of the family he believes he may have harmed.

title: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
overview: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

title: Do Us Part
overview: When Rose—Ryan’s college best friend and unrequited love—crashes his wedding with a change of heart, years of buried emotions threaten to shatter his world. As Ryan reels, his best man must navigate a minefield of secrets to get his friend to "I do" before the past rewrites the future.

title: Thudakkam
overview: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

title: Dragonfly
overview: Nohemí and Mary are two women resisting structural violence in Ciudad Juárez. United by pain and hope, both mothers find inspiration to move their families forward. The dragonfly, a symbol they share, embodies their resilience and capacity for change.

title: Deathwoods
overview: A weekend of camping intended to break Scott out of his post breakup depression, quickly turns  into a weekend of bloodshed, as his friends are picked off one by one by the urban legend that haunts the  woods surrounding the small town of Old Hickory, Tennessee.

title: Capybara
overview: Full animated capybara movie. Plot TBA

title: Brothers by the River
overview: A coming-of-age story of two friends in Mindoro – Niko, a Manila boy, and Ayan, a Mangyan. Their unique bond spans a whole summer of being introduced to each other’s culture and lifestyle, with Niko teaching Ayan how to read, who in turn teaches Niko how to swim.

title: Ganggang
overview: At the first clash of their fighting spiders, Ilay and Ten-ten knew they would go home as losers. Anton, the winner of the fight, will once again lord over their school. At the sideline is Mel, a newcomer and a city boy, watching the rowdy play in awe, unaware that soon he will become an ally of Ilay and Ten-ten against the real neighborhood bully.

title: A.ni.mál
overview: In a provincial Philippine town, the naïve daughter of the mayor comes home with a video of a powerful family friend abusing his dog.

title: 2 Valid IDs
overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

title: Dangeom
overview: A gay Korean-Filipino dancer and his Korean aunt, bound by their patriarch’s dementia, clash over a missing heirloom dagger as they each struggle for acceptance – he in a foreign land; she, within a tradition that denies her.

title: Hand of God
overview: In a remote village scarred by years of conflict, a young army lieutenant introduces football to children. As the game begins to heal wounds and rebuild trust, he forms a fragile bond with a child soldier — forcing both to choose between the innocence they’ve lost and the violent realities of war.

title: The Mothering
overview: Near the 40th day of her estranged father’s death, a woman returns to her family’s ancestral home where three generations of women are bound together by grief, madness, and evil thicker than blood.

title: Status: Rejected
overview: Longing for love and the promise of a better life, a grandmother finds herself swept into an unexpected online romance that challenges her sense of worth, family, and the dreams she refuses to let go of.

title: Only Known to Us
overview: Bound by a love kept in silence, a man struggles to remain seen within a family that once made him feel at home.

title: To Set Upright
overview: Paring Bert, a priest, and his parishioner, Santos, a taxi driver, embark on a gritty journey to reconcile their moral conflicts while they elude an assassination attempt.

title: Harbinger
overview: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

title: The Big Cheese
overview: A clever American team competes for first place at France's Mondial du Fromage cheese competition.

title: Cookie Queens
overview: A celebration of girlhood and the complexities that come with it, Cookie Queens is a coming-of-age story about the joys, pressures, and tensions woven into one of America’s most cherished rituals: Girl Scout Cookie season.

title: My Little Hero
overview: Chubby always eats, walks, and plays alone—until one day, he meets a masked tree spirit named Little Tree under a giant tree. Their bond sparks laughter, friendship, and the creation of the “Little Tree Defense Squad,” where four children protect their secret green haven. But when humans threaten to destroy the tree, Little Tree must return to the forest. For the first time, Chubby steps forward, determined to find his friend and protect the world they love with his own courage.

title: Otter
overview: Bubble, a young otter, lives on an island that had caught on fire. She had swim away to find a new home, she had found a new island that could concur her. But as she becomes aware of their true nature, she has to face her loneliness.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Our Time Will Come
overview: Two orphans, Owusu and Adobea, brave the Ghanaian countryside, with one quest in mind: to find their last legitimate parent who would be able to bring back their identities.

title: Farewell until a free Kosova
overview: Found footage recorded on March 12, 1998, in Germany, documenting Agron and Fitnete as they receive their marriage papers. Surrounded by family, they record heartfelt congratulations and greetings intended for loved ones back in Kosovo. What begins as a celebratory message, slowly shifts into a moment marked by uncertainty and concern about Kosovo.

title: Till We Meet Again on the Starry Hill
overview: Yuri, a high school teacher, lives her busy days carrying a sacred "vow" in her heart: to fulfill the dream of the one she loved, Akira, who aspired to be a teacher but perished in the flames of war. One day, a temporary teacher named Ryo appears. Yuri finds herself constantly seeing traces of Akira in Ryo's casual gestures and words. Though confused by her wavering heart, she desperately tries to suppress her feelings for him, having resolved to love only Akira for the rest of her life.

title: On The Edge Of Childhood
overview: The story of 14-year-old Tamara Eremenko, who finds herself on the brink of survival in besieged Leningrad in the winter of 1942. A convoy of mail trucks arrives in the city for the first time in months. The Main Post Office is desperately short of mail carriers. To survive the winter and save her sister, Tamara must deliver six letters and prove her fitness for the job, only to be hired as a postman.

title: Candidates of Death
overview: A father goes on holiday with his son and two of his friends, during which time they make an amateur horror film together. As the years pass, they continue to shoot scenes for their “handcrafted,” carefree, imaginative horror project, with even more passion, dutiful consistency, and unwavering commitment: the documentary chronicles a decade of this beautiful adventure, as Maciej and the kids become a group of people who grow up… and yet somehow still manage to grow younger together.

title: The Great Punjab Robbery
overview: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.

title: Total Coverage
overview: A compilation of the various angles shot to cover the creation of wet and messy fetish content.

title: THE 8LOCK
overview: Non, a young boy with a talent for writing rap lyrics, dreams of becoming a rapper to support himself and his family. But being born with a stutter turns the very thing he loves most into the hardest thing for him to express.  When he gets the chance to perform on a real rap stage for the first time, Non must face both the judgment of others and the fear of failure that has trapped him for years.  THE 8LOCK is the story of an ordinary kid trying to prove that even if he stumbles, speaks imperfectly, or falls again and again, he still has the right to dream and the courage to chase it.

title: Kamala Miss
overview: Dhurba returns to Kathmandu in search of his former teacher, only to uncover a mysterious connection between his own past and a novel being written about her, blurring the lines between memory, fiction, and reality.

title: Hanuman Ansh
overview: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

title: Genevieve's Garden
overview: After being dumped and laid off in quick succession, Lily finds herself at a rising influencer’s new wellness retreat in the Hudson Valley. Looking for a distraction, she becomes obsessively infatuated with a fellow guest.

title: Metal boy
overview: A homeless man named Keith, Is suspicious about the mayor Bob, for all the changes he's done to the town. Until he finds this helmet that gives him superpowers and uses them to expose Bob's secrets.

title: i wonder shall i fly
overview: Intimately kaleidoscopic archival footage of nature and the African diaspora is paired with 1940s interviews of formerly enslaved people reflecting on their childhoods, allowing a window into Black history through their eyes while exploring life, death, and rebirth.

title: National Sport
overview: As his girlfriend prepares to leave for Australia, a professional queuer who drifts through life without urgency finds it easier to share his fears with strangers in line than confront the end of his relationship, spending his final days suspended between waiting, regret, and the comfort of the present moment.

title: Aligned Apart
overview: Two Strangers. Two Stories. A painful breakup and loss of his job leave Neel searching for purpose, while Tara finds herself struggling to cope with her parents' separation and the uncertainty surrounding her family. As the two unknowingly mirror each other's journeys through loss and healing, their lives repeatedly cross in unexpected ways. Can two lives moving in parallel ever become one?

title: Family: The Musical
overview: Plot is Unkown

title: To Your Island
overview: A paper crane from his ex-boyfriend, a fantasy island composed of his memory, a rabbit with amnesia, some are covered, traces of separation and love. The film is adapted from the Jinjiang Literature City novel "To Your Island".

title: Mutrion
overview: In a lagoon suspended in time, legend has it that sooner or later every inhabitant loses the toenail of their right big toe.

title: Addiction
overview: After finally building the life he once dreamed of, a young man begins to feel suffocated by the constant effort it takes to maintain it. Exhausted and disillusioned, he starts to lose sight of why he worked so hard in the first place.. As his addiction tightens its grip, his reality begins to fracture. Without the substance, his mind spirals-distorting his perception and isolating him from the world around him. Soon, he starts seeing a dark, shadowy version of himself lurking in the distance... watching, waiting, and slowly getting closer. What begins as an escape turns into a psychological nightmare, as the figure grows impossible to ignore-an eerie manifestation of his unraveling mind, and a haunting reflection of the path he's chosen.

title: Halee
overview: The story based on the true event, Chaupadi Pratha; a traditional, discriminatory practice in parts of western Nepal where menstruating or postpartum women and girls are banished from their homes to sleep in isolated huts or animal sheds— still prevailing in fewer places.

title: A Grand Night Out
overview: A girl attends a house party dressed as Aardman's 'Wallace', but she didn't get the memo that bald caps aren't "in"...  A Bristol Film School (Boomsatsuma) film, made in collaboration with Aardman to celebrate "what Aardman means to Bristol" for their 50th anniversary.

title: The Blessing
overview: Several people have barricaded themselves inside a bar. The music must never stop, otherwise something terrible could happen.

title: Phillip Philadelphia
overview: British screenwriter Phillip Philadelphia conducts a retiring life of fantasy, delusion and tawdry eroticism from a Gold Coast motel; meanwhile the ghosts of love and past glory begin to erode his web of reverie.

title: Alterity
overview: A group of paranormal researchers discover a dormant alien invasion force hidden in an abandoned shopping mall slated for demolition.

title: The Newcomers
overview: Three tweens investigate what is poisoning their village's rivers. Mateo narrates as he, his brother Tomas, refugee Tiana, and her dog Nube embark on an adventure to uncover the source of pollution.

title: Yaar Jigree Kasooti Degree
overview: Five estranged college friends reunite years later when an invitation brings them back to campus. As they revive a forgotten youth festival, old bonds return, buried emotions resurface, and their shared past begins to shape their present.

title: Las damas
overview: Alba, an artist-in-residence at the Casa de Velázquez, struggles to find her place in the world and in her own body.

title: Fortune House
overview: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

title: Atopia
overview: The film explores the state of ‘atopia’ that afflicts Socrates in Plato’s *Symposium*. It is an aesthetic experience of stepping outside oneself, which the work conveys by depicting a musical improvisation by cellist Giovanni Sollima as he plays against a backdrop of abstract images created by directly manipulating 35mm film using acid etching, colour, scratches and abrasions. The secret relationship between the musician and his instrument is thus transposed onto the film medium, producing a synaesthetic perception.

title: Ám: Chuỗi Phim Ngắn Linh Dị
Сказка
overview: 70-year-old Larisa and 65-year-old Oleg are lonely members of an amateur "Theater of Honor" for the elderly, where neither is taken seriously. Larisa is denied roles and is made fun of, while Oleg also remains invisible to those around her. At some point, they notice each other, and a romantic connection develops between them, which may be their last attempt to escape their loneliness and feel needed.

title: Get Set Go
overview: A wild adventure where one pedal stroke could change everything.

title: Lan Tha Rae
overview: Lan Tha Rae is a Myanmar horror-drama film produced by Aung Heik Film Production, directed by Academy Nyo Min Lwin, and is a heart-pounding and thrilling watch.

title: Todos Os Meus Amigos Estão Vivendo Um Amor Adolescente
Дарующая счастье
overview: In the dense forests of the Ramon region, where even the echoes recall ancient legends, three brave brothers set out on a journey in search of a winged miracle—a bird that grants wishes. But she has no magic wand, and every wish she makes drains her powers. The brothers must navigate secret paths and understand: happiness is not a trophy. It can only be shared. A new life for the fairy tale by Voronezh storyteller Anna Kupriyanovna Baryshnikova for those who believe in miracles.

title: Мастер
overview: The documentary "Master" is dedicated to one of the most prominent figures in the history of Russian cinema—the brilliant film scholar, Chairman of the Russian State Cinematography Committee, professor at VGIK, and longtime president of the Window to Europe film festival—Armen Nikolaevich Medvedev. The film's central focus is the 1990s, a turning point for the country and a pivotal moment in Medvedev's career. Separate chapters are devoted to VGIK and the Vyborg Film Festival, the film's subject's beloved creative outlets. The film draws on the recollections of colleagues, friends, and students, who speak with sincere warmth and gratitude about the master's role in their lives and the life of Russian cinema.

title: Vizionz
overview: Every frame feels wrong. Every detail raises new questions. The camera captured something he never saw.

title: ST☆R (Stella Marie's Superstar Lookalike)
overview: An obsessed fan literally grafts their idol's standee onto their own skin, only to find their truest self in the friend who stayed to watch them fall apart.

title: Picture
overview: Picture is an upcoming Kannada romantic comedy-drama that celebrates dreams, love, and family relationships with a wholesome entertainer.

title: Awake
overview: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

title: Peregrine Falcon
overview: Two young female serial killers take refuge in an abandoned warehouse to plot their next move. As one of the girls struggles with her role as the de facto leader, the other strives to prove her devotion as a follower.

title: Bottled Up
overview: Simon decides to declare his love to his boss, Melanie, by hosting a romantic dinner at his mom's house. Over the course of the night, a number of unexpected guests show up leading to an onslaught of confusion.

title: Reform
overview: A man spirals within a never-ending work day and is visited by another being.

title: The Seasoning
overview: One man's lunch plans go suddenly awry. Were his cooking skills up to par?

title: Warrior
overview: Jenny's invisible chronic illness has negatively impacted her life for almost a decade. As her next doctor's appointment draws near, painful memories resurface, and the depth of the injustice she has endured becomes clear.

title: At Night
overview: Six women in Paris traverse the neon-soaked anxiety of the city after dark.

title: Lockjaw
overview: Six weeks after getting into a drunk driving accident that leaves her jaw wired shut, Rayna tries to have a fun night out with her friends.

title: Nagi Notes
overview: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.

title: Look At This Freak
overview: A reunion of old friends is disrupted by a hated roommate and an internet monstrosity.

title: Species
overview: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

title: The Showdown
overview: A young man is confronted by a vicious supernatural entity whilst attempting to retrieve some belongings from his ex-boyfriend.

title: Voltei na Foto
overview: Leonardo is a man frustrated with his life until, unexpectedly, he is transported back to 1986. In the past, he encounters his younger self and attempts to change his own future.

title: Времена любви
overview: Artem and Tanya are a young couple who separated a few weeks ago. Despite the breakup, they continue to live together in a rented apartment, unable to separate. Despite the chasm of disappointment and misunderstanding that has arisen, strong feelings remain between the couple. Another argument shatters the unbearable circumstances of their protracted separation. However, the question of "how to be together" hangs over the lovers like an unsettling shadow of indecipherability. Trying to answer it, they spend a long night in the confined space of their apartment. Recalling a past they can no longer return and imagining a future that frightens them with its uncertainty, Tanya and Artem wish to grasp the present, where they can live happily together.

title: Treasure Island
overview: Summer 1993. Marthe, 12, convinces her brother to run away from home and from the Haitian heritage they both reject. Joined by their cousins in a park, they debate what their future might hold. But as the hours pass, the children begin to realize that what they’re trying to escape is also what binds them together most deeply.

title: Summer Tour
overview: Few American demographics are more easily caricatured than Deadheads, those swirling, dosing, hippy-dressed vagabonds. But in his infinitely sweet and wise documentary, director Mischa Richter offers us the Deadheads as complex, self-aware and resourceful members of a wandering commune, one that’s admirable for its kindness and care.

title: The Latcher
overview: An overworked midwife, hollowed by an unspoken personal tragedy, is haunted by waking nightmares of an eerie presence that creeps from the shadowy bushland into the home where she lost everything.

title: Puppy
overview: When a woman returns to her childhood home to care for her father, the stuffed animal from her past-once a source of comfort-becomes a haunting conduit for unresolved grief, guilt, and the terrifying possibility that a past family tragedy is repeating itself in the present.

title: The Last First: Winter K2
overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

title: Until You're Alone
overview: After becoming the lead suspect in a series of brutal slayings, a close-minded architect must team up with a free-spirited sex worker in order to clear his name and solve the crimes before they become the killer's next victims in this suspenseful, stylish, and hilarious queer love letter to Hitchcock, De Palma, and the Italian giallo.

title: Demon Agent
overview: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

title: THE RIBBON HERO
overview: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

title: Ghost of Ueno
overview: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.

title: AORTA
overview: Late night house parties with friends who can't understand and ephemeral conversations with an unnaturally familiar face.  AORTA is a film of teenage identity, discovery, emptiness and the hope for a future not yet lived.

title: Самая лёгкая лодка в мире
overview: A feature film based on the novella by Yuri Koval, recounting a whimsical and humorous journey aboard a homemade boat through the Vologda region. The picture consists of two parallel storylines. The first follows the adventures of the novella’s protagonist, whose absurd escapade unexpectedly transforms into a mystical experience amidst the rivers, marshes, and villages of the countryside. The second centers on a theatrical production based on Koval’s book — staged by a group of students — which reveals the backstory: how the book’s hero came to yearn to break free from Moscow and retreat far away from everyone — including his friends — deep into the heart of nature.

title: Stupid Children
overview: A man ends up seeking a violent solution to his relationship issues after encountering an aggressive dog.

title: André Rieu's 2026 Summer Concert: Viva Maastricht!
Scratch And Whine
overview: A desperate dog owner decides to take care of an old woman at a house in the middle of nowhere.

title: Sawdust
overview: To afford an attorney for their immigrant father in detention, a former construction worker must perform as a femme fatale and seduce a wealthy client.

title: Plane Film
overview: In an effort to continue using filmmaking as exposure therapy (after conquering her fear of the Tube in Tube Film), filmmaker Orla Smith tackles an even bigger fear: planes. On a trip to Porto, the camera is wielded as a shield against panic attacks. But this time, things don’t go exactly to plan.

title: We Are Not Dreaming
overview: Ciro, an overworked medical student and pole dance instructor, loses stability as Brazil’s university system collapses. Forced out of his home, he finds refuge with Antônio, a reclusive DJ, a meeting that reshapes both their survival and intimacy.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 13
overview: The thirteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 8, 2026, at Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between OSKAR and Callum Newman.

title: Absolutely Devoted to You
overview: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

title: Eramus
overview: After a romantic interest vanishes without explanation, a woman becomes convinced he is dead. With only her phone as a companion, her katabasis through online spaces leads her to psychic mediums, obscure forum communities, social media archives, and conversations with LLMs. As her search deepens, her rabbit-hole investigation leads her through the histories of moving images, digital collective memory, and the new spiritual languages emerging in a technological age.

title: Khufu
overview: At the Giza Pyramids, 14-year-old Saeed and his mother Ekram face the fate of their dying camel, Khufu.

title: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
overview: Filmed over twenty-five years, The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer traces the lives of two inseparable cousins, Guillermina and Belinda, as they grow up in the vast Argentine Pampas.

title: Coming Down The Road: The Summer Blockbuster Tour
overview: A documentation of Cleveland artists Puma Thurman, DoHM, Meladite, and Irewyrm as they go on their first ever tour across the United States.

title: Instinto
overview: Following Karol’s kidnapping and murder, three suspects become the focus of the investigation. As different accounts of the events come to light, dark secrets and unexpected revelations turn the search for the truth into a dangerous game of lies.

title: Singularity
overview: 15,000 years before our era, during the Pleistocene, just before the great ice age, three saber-toothed tigers are born in a cave. One of them is markedly different from the others.

title: Together
overview: An exploration of human desires for land ownership and property through archival footage and social media.

title: Private Property
overview: Two outsiders – Maya, a Nepali immigrant working overnight to build a future, and Danny, an unhoused Black veteran searching for warmth and shelter – clash over one small space. Maya reaches for the law, then a gun, to belong.

title: She Stole My Son's Heart
overview: After her last heart transplant fails, Maria is in desperate need of a new heart. Fearing it could give out at any moment, she turns down her boyfriend’s proposal and heads out for a walk — only to mysteriously disappear. As the search intensifies, homicide and missing persons detective Vicky and her rookie partner are assigned to the case. With Maria's time running out, it becomes a race to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance before her failing heart gives out.

title: Благоустройство
overview: A hot summer is in full swing. A bronze Pushkin has taken up residence in the city of N. Garbage truck driver Pyotr drives along familiar routes, emptying sun-baked bins. Everyone waits for rain, but only furious thunder rumbles on the sultry evenings, doing nothing to cool the hot Earth. Only the splash of a small fountain offers relief from the stifling boredom. A wedding is in preparation. Pyotr is planning to marry off his only son, a cold and stern figure who is steadfast in his love for his parents. At night, the fountain retires, leaving only Pushkin's bronze shoulder, a place to cool a head weary from the day...

title: Lilla Marie
overview: After a dream convinces her she is going to die, Marie, a wife and mother with a seemingly perfect life, begins to question if the life everyone admires is the one she truly wanted. Leaving her family behind, she invites a mysterious woman to join her on a journey of desire, longing, and self-discovery.

title: CAIMI
overview: In a public square, a woman and a group of strangers are swept up in a collective, erratic, and irresistible dance.

title: Slogans (Part One)
overview: "The Interview"

title: The Taste of Tea
overview: A Japanese boy returns to his late father’s hometown in Taiwan, where tea becomes the bridge between memory, grief, and newfound family.

title: A Happy Ending
overview: A young woman chooses an unconventional path to achieve financial independence, aiming to support the people in her life in a culture that disapproves of her choices.

title: Her Ciro
overview: A radio tower operator calls his wife in wartime.

title: The Fig Tree
overview: A girl finds herself in the crotch of a tree, abundant with figs - endless possibilities for her future, ripe and perfect, just within reach.

title: Degree of Certainty
overview: When a young risk analyst at a major US oil company in 1982 learns that the climate research department has just discovered a rapid rise in global temperatures, he has to decide on which side of history he wants to be.

title: HYSTERIA
overview: Between subway rides and afternoons in the park, a young man and a young woman share simple moments of a seemingly ordinary routine. Gestures, glances, and brief encounters silently reveal a relationship defined by affection and longing.

title: Another Day
overview: After a video of a street brawl between Albin and a stranger goes viral, his father decides to send him away to Dubai, leaving him unsettled by how suddenly everything in his life has changed. A day before his departure, Albin slips out of home in search of the man he fought with. What begins as a search for closure takes an unexpected turn when he meets Marty, the stranger he was looking for, and as the day unfolds, anger slowly gives way to understanding, reconciliation and the healing of old wounds.

title: RARE
overview: A man’s dream first date is put at risk when intense headaches threaten to disrupt the moment.

title: Wakey Wakey
overview: Zombaby puts the fun in funeral in the gory sequel to the award-winning 'Teething Problems'.

title: Expectations
overview: After a successful first date, Jonathan and Lisa stop in the park to talk, but find themselves in an awkward silence.

title: Let the jury decide
overview: After an electoral fraud, a desperate mayor turns to two petty criminals to cover his tracks, but a series of unexpected mistakes puts the entire operation at risk.

title: The Woman is Perfected
overview: In a destructive relationship she can’t escape, a young woman’s obsession with becoming flawless spirals into a fixation deadlier than love itself.

title: PROXY
overview: Clyde and his Al girlfriend, Alora, excitedly try a new service that installs Alora into a real, live, human body. But the dream becomes a nightmare when they find out the body proxies are not sourced as advertised. Now Alora is faced with a devastating choice.

title: Gabin
overview: Gabin, the youngest child of the Jourdel family, is set to take over his father's butcher shop. Torn between family loyalty and a desire to break free, he has other dreams.

title: irregular
overview: a collection of vignettes illustrating a typical tuesday at a dive bar in New York City.

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: Holofiction
overview: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.

title: Extra Geography
overview: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood — friendship, boys, studies, and growing up — and embark on their school project, falling in love.

title: Atcha Atcha
overview: This is the final year of the Master’s program at the prestigious dance school École des Sables. Dancers from across Africa enter under the guidance of Germaine Acogny.

title: House of Death
overview: At night, a boy is terrorized by a dark latex figure.

title: Brave New Love
overview: Hypnotherapist Kate lives with her husband, Orla, and their daughter, Athena, while simultaneously maintaining a deeply romantic - and highly secret - relationship with Andreas. As a role model to her daughter, she struggles to navigate her existential quest - a journey filled with body fluids, intimacy, Greek mythology, laughter, madness, and clumsiness. We follow Kate through darkness and sunshine in this erotic, existential modern love story, as she battles society’s norms and dares to redefine the rules of love.

title: The Education of Jane Cumming
overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

title: Forgotten Spaceman
overview: In 1988, Abdul Ahad Momand became Afghanistan's first and only astronaut. From orbit, he called his mother, making Pashto the fourth language spoken in space. Below him, his nation was collapsing.

title: Another Day in the Metal Box
overview: When a Ukrainian factory worker finds a mysterious object hidden in an abandoned workshop, he must choose between the safety of the life he knows and the dream he has never dared to pursue.

title: Adaraneeya Tharuwak
overview: A singer’s journey to fame becomes a journey of love, loss, and a final promise to the woman he could never forget.

title: Words From The Void
overview: A young man has to grapple with an intense moral dilemma.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 14
overview: The fourteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 9, 2026, at G Messe Gunma in Takasaki, Gunma, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and Yuto-Ice.

title: Digby & Camille
overview: In this tender, intimate and humorous documentary, experience the adventures and frustrations of a pair of inseparable lovers as they dream of building a life together

title: Jean-Paul Goude : le voleur de couleurs
The Wind, One Brilliant Day
overview: “The wind, one brilliant day, called to my soul with an odor of jasmine.” Last autumn, actress Tang Wei softly recited these lines in English while sitting beside director Ben Rivers on a fallen tree trunk in the outskirts of London. Together, they carefully searched for the poem's rhythm, as the wind rustled through the trees.

title: My Father's Kora
overview: Souleymane, an Afro-German trans man, travels from Berlin to Dakar to repair his father’s kora, and in doing so, himself. A fragile search for harmony between body, sewing, ocean, heritage, and faith.

title: Sixteen Moments of My Life
overview: Ingrid Caven sings about 16 moments from her life in a unique concert at the Théâtre des Bouffes du Nord in Paris.

title: Destroy All Girls
overview: Alex bolts from her stifling home to ride with a band of inline street skaters. Bouncing around New York City with nothing other than skates and a camcorder, escape comes easy at first. But as family and identity collide, she's forced to face the one thing she can't outride – herself.

title: Revolutionaries Never Die
overview: Seeking to decode a final, unanswered invitation, a filmmaker explores why the renowned Lebanese director Jocelyne Saab reached out for a collaboration just two months before her passing.

title: Shadow Wounds
overview: After waking alone in a dark forest with no memory of how she got there, a young woman follows a mysterious lantern while being haunted by whispers that seem to know her deepest fears. As reality and nightmare begin to merge, she must confront the truth hidden within the shadows before it consumes her completely.

title: Respirer une fois sur trois
overview: In group strength-training classes, people breathe in unison every day. Charlyne lifts weights alongside three retired women who love to sing.

title: Hollow Girls
overview: On the night of June 2, 2023, a shocking crime shattered a quiet community. Six teenage girls lured one of their classmates into a deadly trap. Fueled by jealousy and a twisted desire for revenge, they set into motion a plan that would end in kidnapping, torture, and murder.

title: Bird on Elephant’s Path
overview: An unusual day in the life of two men dressed as mascots - one a bird, the other an elephant.

title: A Flash and How It Lasts
overview: Living in Los Angeles, a young Chinese gay man longs for the connection with his estranged father that seems out of reach. One day, his father visits him from China, and he discovers the tenderness and sorrow of his father that he had never seen before.

title: Monkey Drum
overview: a folk nightmare

title: Them
overview: A Soviet spy, embedded in the U.S. as a sleeper agent, discovers his home has been bugged and must decide whether to reveal his identity to his American daughter while keeping the truth hidden from those listening in.

title: Three Housewives and a Body
overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

title: Monstrous Me
overview: When Ariel was a disabled and disfigured child of three years old, a bad babysitter brought over a bag of weed, her boyfriend, and a VHS of A Nightmare on Elm Street. From under the coffee table, through the railings, Ariel saw themselves in that Zenith television, in the face of Freddy Krueger, and decided there was agency in being a monster rather than a martyr.

title: Miso Soup
overview: College student Reiko enrolls in a Japanese-language class to learn her heritage language. However, she begins to fall behind and feels like she is not Japanese enough. In turn, Reiko has to navigate her own feelings about having a dual identity.

title: LAGUM Ao Vivo na Amazônia
overview: LAGUM Ao Vivo na Amazônia is part of Lagum’s 2026 plans, following LAGUM Ao Vivo no Bondinho (RJ). The band brings its music to the heart of the Amazon for a special live performance surrounded by the beauty of the rainforest. The project celebrates music, nature, and Brazilian culture, while supporting the conservation of the Amazon. All CO₂ emissions from the production were compensated through the REDD+ Jutaítuba Project.

title: Orion
overview: A holiday at home. A holiday with an end in sight. A birthday to start it all.

title: Agbogbloshie
overview: The world replaced six thousand phones this morning. All of them are burning in Agbogbloshie, in the heart of Accra, where six thousand people make a living stripping copper from what you replaced. They breathe air five times more polluted than what the WHO considers safe. No one keeps track of what they die from. He lives there. And while everyone else scavenges for weight, he searches for the part that still works. With a washing machine motor, laptop batteries, and spliced wires, he raises a streetlight in the middle of the alley where he lives. That night, for the first time in twenty-two years, the street had light. That's why they found him. Fiction set in a place that exists.

title: Wandering Trees
overview: Piero and his son Giuliano live alone, on the edge of town, in a farmhouse filled with injured animals they collect and care for. The Nonne, local notables, want to drive them out because they live like vagrants. During a snowfall, Piero disappears and the animals are killed. Giuliano has no choice but to search for his father.

title: Epitaph
