overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: A Girl Unknown
overview: A Chinese girl is passed between three families from the age of 6 to 18, receiving each time a new name and identity. As she searches for belonging and the possibility of love, she has to navigate between the weight of her past and the uncertainty of her future, until she finds her own way.

title: Despite the Night
overview: Months after a volcanic eruption, a cloud of ash still looms overhead, plunging much of northern Australia into a perpetual night. As a city empties, days bleed into nights, seasons vanish, and time begins to rot. Inside a quiet apartment, two brothers face the slow death of their world, and a faster one inside their home.

title: The Bigfoot Experiment
overview: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.

title: Blank Slate
overview: Claiming to remember every moment of her life, a woman spirals between past and present during an interview with her local news, revealing the hidden cost of a life she can never leave behind.

title: Hearing
overview: Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.

title: Ruinas circulares
overview: In the sacred valley of Túcume, where time seems to stand still, sounds awaken hidden memories. The echo of drums and the vibration of the air envelop us in a sonic ritual: a bridge between the visible and the invisible, between the ancestral and the eternal.

title: Mayflies
overview: Outgoing Willow and awkward Cath, both 22, reunite six months after uni to scatter their rabbit's ashes. In the sunlit countryside, they dance through grief, desire and courage-one kiss rekindles old feelings but letting go sets them free.

title: The Wanderers
overview: 1957. As a farewell for her lover Teresa, Zurda and her friends go on one of their usual weekend camp-outs in the middle of the woods. A time stolen for rest, playfulness and illicit pleasures, away from the watchful eye of Franco’s dictatorship.

title: September Afternoon
overview: A couple refuses to accept that summer is over. For a last time, they head to the coast with the intention of spending two afternoons together between sand dunes and sea water. The temperatures have long been too cold for sandals and shorts; the blustery autumn wind is no substitute for cosy rays of summer sun. On the way to the beach, they cross paths with a woman they know loosely. Upon arrival, they look in vain for a dune to take shelter from the wind; a small dam is built and defended hard against the tide, an attempt to erect a windbreak is made. These desperate struggles against the encroaching elements are merely a brief interlude before the situation unravels into a disaster of an entirely different magnitude. A contemporary cosmic catastrophe.

title: In All My Journeys I Am Returning
overview: Karl and Petronella, a young Swedish couple, sail in search of fortune. The river carries them through desolate lands in the aftermath of the war of independence.

title: Nine on the Line
overview: When a new player appears on the horizon, the old order in the pool club begins to fall apart and the real game is played far beyond the table.

title: Asphalt Guerrilla
overview: In the aftermath of a bank robbery, a member of a guerrilla political organisation encounters a mob.

title: Tomb of Dreams
overview: Louis and Lénore have sought refuge in a lonely house by the sea. As in a dream, zombies appear, wandering at nightfall. Do they really exist?

title: Apostate
overview: A Mormon teenager receives his mission call, but isn't sure if he wants to go. When he goes to pray about it in the forest, he has a terrifying encounter.

title: Live Crickets
overview: Cass throws an impromptu funeral for her oldest friend, two weeks after her boyfriend dumped her and moved out. As Cass walks through the sea of people she thought might be her friends, we watch her realize just how alone she truly is.

title: Her Silence
overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia.

title: Soft Gaze
overview: Lonely police officer Georgie becomes fascinated by a queer couple she observes at the beach, recognising their soft intimacy as something missing from her own emotionally arid heterosexual relationship. Time slows eerily and soothing touches and sounds grow sinister as her fixation becomes charged with hungry sensuality.

title: Rebel Flowers
overview: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

title: The LGBTQ+ Films: Q
overview: Have you also experienced that your LGBTQ+ allies show support on their own terms? Noah meets his brother to arrange their mother's birthday, but the event takes an unexpected turn when Noah's queerness is brought up in the conversation.

title: The Sick Mind of EDP445
overview: The downfall of the controversial internet figure Bryant Moreland, known as EDP445, after a 2021 online sting operation involving a 13-year-old changed the course of his life.

title: Dementium
overview: Wyatt Bailey retreats to a secluded cabin to solve his mother’s murder. After taking DMT to confront his dead father, he’s torn between visions of his ex-girlfriend offering hope and a witch urging destruction in a battle for his soul.

title: Soft Gaze
overview: Lonely police officer Georgie becomes fascinated by a queer couple she observes at the beach, recognising their soft intimacy as something missing from her own emotionally arid relationship. As she begins to follow the women, time slows eerily and soothing touches and sounds grow sinister as her fixation becomes charged with hungry sensuality.

title: Daylight
overview: An isolated man, living in a new city, resorts to a hook up site in a desperate attempt to make a human connection.

title: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
overview: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.

title: Paradise
overview: The enigmatic captain of a burning cargo ship binds together the fates of two families; one in a bustling Ghanaian city, the other in a quiet Canadian town.

title: The Riverbank
overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

title: Nimrods
overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

title: Have A Heart
overview: Diana has a vendetta against dating. When led to a surprise blind date by her boy-mad best friend, Solana,  she gets blindsided by an accidental love arrow—courtesy of a burned-out Cupid and a date with an agenda.

title: Enigma
overview: Natalie and Miles fall into an unusual dream in a dark room.

title: Confessions of a Shaman
overview: A man who decides to inherit the art of shamanism to exact personal revenge, leading to a series of terrifying events that change his life forever.

title: Sad Girlz
overview: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

title: Sawtooth Mountain
overview: Three college students get entangled in a horrifying ordeal after booking a Bigfoot-themed cabin run by two paranormal-obsessed brothers.

title: Paradeisa
overview: Struggling to keep their family together, Lou helps her broke artist father fake his own death to boost the value of his work. But as the lie of cat litter ashes grows, she realises that letting go might be the only way forward.

title: Piluk
overview: Born from a single feather, young Piluk walks on, just as her mother did before her. Throughout her journey, she offers feathers from her thinning wings to passersby and wounded animals. From the raw landscapes of the tundra to a city of concrete, will she still be able to hear the breath of the wind that witnessed her birth?

title: The Last Assassins
overview: The world lives in a permanent winter and is shrouded in a deadly fog. In the distant future, Nobel must take a young girl to her aunt, whom she has never met, after her father has been killed. He has sworn to protect the members of that family, and few remain. When they arrive at an abandoned laboratory, holograms tell the family’s story. But can the digital world become physical? The young woman may be the solution.

title: Angel777
overview: Genc, an out of work fringe blogger devoted to anonymous research, lives with his partner Bora in Prishtina, Kosovo. While Genc holds on to hopes for a brighter future, Bora, burdened by financial strain, unfulfilled dreams, and fed up with his detachment, storms out after a heated argument. Now he must find where she’s gone before it’s too late for them.

title: In Dreams When You Can't Sleep at Night
overview: 15 years ago, Ariel completed my military service in the Israeli army's spokesperson unit. Today, based on real texts I found during my time there, I open up a dialogue with a young Israeli sniper.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 15
overview: The fifteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 11, 2026, at Nisho Highway Arena in Tsu, Mie, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Gabe Kidd and Yuya Uemura.

title: Wilderness
overview: A suburban doctor-mom in crisis reconnects with old friend Kaz on a road trip through Victoria's high country. Their escape turns perilous, leading Allie to face her life's troubles and learn about connection.

title: Under One Roof
overview: Dani, a product of divorce and a single mother, is working from home while caring for her peppery, sick mother when her bohemian father shows up on her doorstep, homeless. What follows is a cramped, chaotic reunion about family, friction, and being stuck together.

title: Meet Cute In the CCU
overview: In the waiting room of a hospital's Cardiac Care Unit, two strangers, Sophia and Emilio, await word about their respective loved ones in surgery. Seeing Sophia is near panic, Emilio starts a conversation about topics innocuous (incompetent winking, the meaning of corniness) and profound (life's journey). In the process they make a connection that will forever alter the course of both of their lives.

title: I Have Laughed Again
overview: Lan, a stoic counselor, masks her soul's fractures with professional restraint until she meets Zhen-Zhen. The rebellious dropout's fragmented talk of a fatal car accident strikes a terrifying chord—it is the same tragedy that claimed Lan's lover. What begins as therapy spirals into a dangerous obsession.

title: Summer Meadow
overview: Hana works as an apprentice shepherdess, leading an isolated life in the Alps, far from the hustle and bustle of the world and the echoes of her native Lebanon. The arrival of Lisa, who has been sent to help her with the animals, forces her out of her solitude and invites her to reconnect with her own story.

title: BAKMA
overview: In Tunisia, Commissioner Ali and Khaled investigate the ritualistic murder of a young woman. Her limbs have been severed, her head is missing, and in its place, the killer has grotesquely sewn the head of a dog.

title: The Cuts
overview: Theatre faculty spar over outlandish financial schemes to keep their department afloat. The arts are worth saving - but can these bozos do it?

title: The Hollywood Blacklist: The Survivors Tell Their Stories
overview: Featuring previously unseen footage from an early-1980s Los Angeles party honouring the blacklistees. (Note: this is an expanded version of footage previously used in "La dernière fête des blacklistés", 2025)

title: Typhoon Mambo
overview: Rusmee keeps interacting with Chalerm, her dead husband, in the form of an AI chatbot.

title: Aurora Borealis
overview: Following two polar bear cubs born in captivity at Nyíregyháza Animal Park in Hungary.

title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

title: Peter
overview: Young Canadian Alden Brown traveled from Nova Scotia to Hollywood in the early 1980s and became one of the biggest porn stars ever.

title: Cheesecake
overview: A husband sets out to buy cheesecake for his pregnant wife, only to be swallowed by city chaos as she goes into labor alone.

title: Like a Mammoth to a Giant Flame
overview: LIke a Mammoth to a Giant Flame is a 45 minute documentary/concert film about the Montreal band Mellow Casualty.

title: Shackled
overview: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

title: Bicycle Thieves
overview: Nano, a South Central native, pursues his stolen bicycle on one long night of chaos. If he can’t navigate through a sea of drunken college students and come out on the other end with his bike, he will lose everything.

title: Inferno
overview: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

title: Arama
overview: Selay seeks refuge in a women's shelter with her newborn baby, but isolation, mistrust, and envy make her stay difficult. Faced with the choice between returning to her violent ex-partner and searching for safety, she must decide which path to choose for herself and her child.

title: The Leader
overview: In 1997, thirty-nine members of the American cult known as "Heaven's Gate" committed the largest mass suicide to ever take place on American soil. This is their story.

title: Tear Gas
overview: 16-year-old Elene and her war-scarred family are drawn into a mass protest in Tbilisi that transforms the streets into a battleground for freedom, forcing them to confront the fractures already threatening to tear them apart.

title: Sacrifice
overview: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
overview: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

title: Sour Minnows
overview: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty L.A. street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As reality grows porous and memory begins to slip, a delirious new logic takes hold.

title: The Rhino Skin
overview: A reporter for a popular newspaper and a criminal lawyer have their destinies linked by a murder that shocked Brazil in the 1970s and marked the beginning of the debate on femicide.

title: Down the Arm of God
overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

title: The Burglars
overview: An elderly woman, Eunja, who lives in the countryside, teams up with Palbok, a burglar, to embark on a spree of robbing empty houses.

title: An Eye for an Eye
overview: Convicted of murdering her husband, Tahereh served her sentence and now faces a ticking clock to negotiate with her in-laws who, under Sharia law, have the legal right to either execute her or forgive her- for a price.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: A Turkish case
overview: Mathieu distanced himself from his Turkish community to climb the social ladder. A determined lawyer, he works hard to become a partner at an influential Parisian law firm. When a young Turkish man in a precarious situation who needs help bursts into his life, Mathieu is drawn into a corruption scandal that threatens to destroy everything he has built.

title: AS IF
overview: Maya finds an old love letter that describes places in her city—places that have vanished or changed beyond recognition. She walks through these lost locations, guided only by the memories of someone she never knew.

title: The Other Mahmoud
overview: It follows two contradictory young men with the same name, which puts them in unexpected, strange and funny situations at the same time.

title: Partisan's Wife
overview: The film takes place in the summer of 2019, but in a world still under a dictatorship rule. Daegu Police Counterintelligence detectives In-hyeok and Sang-jun are monitoring Lee Su-gyeong, wife of Choi Myeong-hun, who is wanted for violating security laws. In-hyeok feels compassion for the pregnant Su-gyeong living in hardship. The film is both a road movie about In-hyeok, Su-gyeong, and Sang-jun, and a story about people forced to hide in the mountains from corrupt power.

title: Every Now and Then, I Fall Apart
overview: Haunted by her best friend’s overdose, Eden numbs her grief through fleeting intimacy and quiet self-destruction. A sudden call from God pulls her back to the site of the death, where she’s offered a choice that forces her to confront what she’s been avoiding—and what she’s willing to destroy.

title: Un grand raccourci
overview: When their family restaurant is on the verge of closing, two cousins release rats in an attempt to set themselves up as pest control experts. That same summer, two young women rig the local beauty contest to promote their jewelry. Caught up in their chaotic schemes, these four resourceful young people searching for a better future eventually cross paths.

title: Harvey & Maude
overview: For years, Maude has remained housebound, her home a refuge from a world that feels both hostile and alien. Meanwhile, Harvey —a long-forgotten imaginary friend— wanders aimlessly through a realm of the unremembered. Though worlds apart, their paths are destined to cross, and their lives begin to brighten as they realize that imagination hasn't faded quite yet.

title: Fast
overview: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

title: Mama
overview: In a quest to terminate the pregnancy, a young woman faces her first grown-up experience.

title: The Thai Interpreter
overview: Following a difficult divorce, Ladawan, a Thai interpreter in California, finds the strength to continue her career with the help of her vibrant colleague Stefani and a supportive new acquaintance, Nicholas. The film follows her through high-stakes legal and medical cases, weaving together the lives of four Thai individuals: Ananya, facing an attempted murder trial; Noot, caught in a trafficking case; Daranee, battling cancer; and Sommai, a Muay Thai coach surviving a tragic crash. It is an intense, heartfelt look at the vital role of communication in life’s most critical moments.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 16
overview: The sixteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 12, 2026, at Act City Hamamatsu in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and SANADA.

title: Tina Arena: Unravel Me
overview: How do you separate a Melbourne-born Oz music treasure and cosmopolitan star from a resilient woman? Follow the threads of her story, in her own words.

title: The Architect Who Built His Own Collapse
overview: When a former activist-turned-architect joins a redevelopment project led by his old comrade, now the city mayor, he finds himself wandering through a landscape of demolition, as memory, reality, and the ideals they once shared begin to collapse.

The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

overview: Observing a slowly deteriorating strip mall before its destruction at a unknown time.

title: Agadha
overview: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

title: Black Beauty
overview: Sroy, a former famous actress known for her irresistible charm, discovers that her husband, Sin, a powerful and influential politician, has been secretly having an affair with a young female university student. She therefore joins forces with her Affair to bring them both public humiliation.

title: Confession or: Bondary Project
overview: a boy looks back on the story of his old memories and relationship that buried in the past.

title: Eclipse Memorial
overview: a Myanmar woman confronts an elderly Thai woman, as personal memories become intertwined with the weight of collective history.

title: Slice of Life
overview: A slice of life in the big city as two neighbors confront their feelings for one another

title: Water Walls
overview: When Vera’s home suddenly burns down, her only purpose becomes to find her cat — likely lost in the fire. The search through the ruins and Vera’s journey through the night forces her to confront not only loss but also the suffocating dependence on parent figures that has defined her life so far.

title: FUCK MULTIVERSE
overview: A busy working man who rarely finds the time to visit his mother meets versions of himself from across the multiverse, forcing him to ask: with the time he has left, is it still enough to fix things?

title: Cottontail
overview: In the wake of her father's death, a young woman experiences an immaculate pregnancy that crosses species lines.

title: In Between Home
overview: Bam, a 21-year-old recent graduate, is about to begin her working life in Bangkok. After avoiding questions about returning home for a long time, she decides to return to her hometown in Isan to visit her grandmother. Her return makes Bam realize that her grandmother has grown old and is no longer as strong as she remembers. At the same time, she meets Nuan, a young woman from the village who has been helping to care for her grandmother. A feeling of being replaced slowly begins to take hold. Bam is forced to confront the question she has avoided for so long: should she stay and care for the person she loves, or leave to begin a life of her own?

title: COOKeD
overview: Prosthetic limbs were developed to overcome the limitations of labor. Teng, a 22-year-old rural man, gives up his hand to get a job, only to face an unexpected fate.

title: Pallaburusu
overview: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

title: Passará
overview: In this short film resulted of a exchange between artists from Brazil and South Korea, an inattentive man must face the world around him after being transformed into a bird.

title: MORIA
overview: Different stages of the life — past, present and even future — of the legendary Argentine vedette Moria Casán, showing how her figure as a cultural icon was built.

title: Flesh & Fuel
overview: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

title: My Wife Cries
overview: A normal working day on a construction site. Thomas, a 40-year-old crane operator, receives a call from his wife asking him to pick her up from the hospital. He finds her crying.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Yes, Mistress
overview: At 61, Steve leads a seemingly ordinary routine life. But behind this facade hides a much more complex universe: that of BDSM, where the body becomes a field of pleasure and exploration of submission. This anthropologically inspired documentary paints an intimate portrait of this man who, through his fantasies, seeks to redefine his relationship with the body, desire and his deep identity. By diving into his most abstract motivations, the film questions what this quest for control… and abandonment reveals.

title: Infernal
overview: Infernal follows Azrael, a young man bound to forces beyond his control as rival powers close in around him. His journey in search of his wife tests his loyalty and betrayal ignites a struggle that will decide the world’s fate.

title: Cakey Heaven
overview: On the morning of her childhood dog’s 13th birthday, Florrie is hard at work in the kitchen, preparing the perfect surprise for her senior terrier, Coco Merrytail - one final, wordless celebration of a bond that’s nearing its soft, inevitable fade.

title: Equal
overview: ARASI, an emerging Carnatic singer. AZHAGHU, a freelance software engineer. Their six-year-old daughter, BHOOMI.  On a post-pandemic day under curfew, Arasi prepares for her long-awaited concert. Azhaghu faces an important job interview. Bhoomi has an online school event.  Azhaghu calls his parents, THILLAI and MOHANA for support.  The family's everyday life unfolds the poetic irony of a perpetual mindset, utterly convinced of its own hierarchy, then turns around and calls it EQUAL.

title: AnyMart
overview: A supermarket as both a microcosm of Japanese society and the setting for a socially critical horror film. Expressionless faces and a supervisor who demands zombie-like friendliness. Only the young Sakai doesn’t stop hoping.

title: The Way We Move
overview: Amber Galloway, a trailblazer in ASL interpretation, takes us on a journey into the deep bond between the Deaf world and music. We follow her as she teaches struggling recruits who she hopes will have what it takes to join her at ACL music festival.

title: Forever Your Maternal Animal
overview: After years studying in Europe, Elsa returns to Costa Rica to reunite with her family. She finds her younger sister living alone in the family home, growing increasingly distant and reclusive, as if slipping into a world of her own. Their parents, meanwhile, are absorbed in their own lives. Her father drifts through a series of affairs, while her mother is immersed in republishing the erotic poems of her youth, neither fully grasping the urgency of the situation. Elsa’s return draws the three women into a confrontation with what still binds them, despite everything.

title: My Little Blue Heart
overview: In a near future in rural Britain, Mustafa and his deaf sister Amna are torn apart by immigration vigilantes and their far-right policies. Amna escapes to search for her brother, only to witness a tragic event.

title: The Angel in the House
overview: Angela is living a life devoted to everyone but herself. Disconnected from her husband, Malcolm, and struggling to articulate her dissatisfaction, she leaves home the night before her family is set to attend a wedding.

title: After the Curtain Falls
overview: After joining a school theatre production to cope with a shaky home life, Cole is forced to deal with his trauma directly after a tragic event blurs the lines between art and reality.

title: Ecoado - Orion: Histórias Depois do Fim
Here is New York
overview: After receiving a call from his ex-girlfriend Ava, Sam (Donivan Fait)  is too afraid to answer. As he tries to avoid confronting the past, he becomes overwhelmed by memories of their relationship, forcing him to relive moments he thought he had left behind.

title: Bubbles
overview: Justyna, an immigrant housemaid, grows close to her wealthy employer as her own living conditions worsen. Facing eviction,  she discovers something that will irreversibly change their relationship.

title: Shutterbug
overview: A rave photographer struggles to navigate a complex power dynamic with his boss, which comes to a head at an after party in Glasgow.

title: Heavenly
overview: Gustavo embarks on a drug-fueled journey to say goodbye to his ex-partner. Trapped in his memories, he relives the self-destructive spiral of their relationship, which was marked by excess and drugs.

title: Pang
overview: Surreal, sexy, and spectral. The summer before Cam leaves for university, childhood best friends Cam and Evie are haunted by the breakdown of their grey-area, queer friendship. As they laze by the pool, they test the limits of their relationship, and try to define who they are to each other.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 18
overview: The eighteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 15, 2026 at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, and included Hiroyoshi Tenzan's retirement match against Satoshi Kojima. The event also featured both tournament semifinals to determine the finalists.

title: Of Womb
overview: Evading the hard truth of their religious matriarch’s death, three sisters gestate dark ecstasies of faith and folk horror. Blessed be Mother.

title: Saint Anthony
overview: A darkly comic portrait of a troubled young man on the day of his mother’s funeral.

title: Horizons
overview: When Fiona visits her childhood home for her mum’s birthday, absent family members and her mum’s unsettling indifference to it forces Fiona to consider whether clinging to tradition is the best way forward....

title: Empty Heaven
overview: When a lonely Iranian dissident becomes embroiled with a local criminal mob in Canada, their bullish bidding leads to complex turns of events.

title: Skerry & May
overview: In the near future, May returns to a remote Scottish island for one last conversation with her lost partner, in a world drifting between memory and simulation, laying bare both grief and the limits of technology.

title: Passing Place
overview: A woman awakes on a surreal purgatorial island after being mistakenly declared dead.

title: Bergamot
overview: A surreal, experimental look at place, memory and internal conflict.

title: Vimar
overview: A short, unsettling story of a man and his violent, haunting dream involving a swan.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

title: Amaretti
overview: When septuagenarian Lennie's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity.

title: Holiness
overview: In Sarapampa, preparations for the centenary of the Virgin of the Maize are marred by the visit of the Archbishop. His unfriendly attitude is generating growing discontent among the inhabitants, who remain united to protect the honor of their community.

title: Session(s)
overview: A mix-up turns two couples' sessions into a fiasco.

title: The Widower
overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

title: Hushar Pittalu
overview: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

title: Awake at Night
overview: Milena is in her early twenties. Nothing fulfills her, nothing excites her, and she can't bear being alone. She loses herself in the night to fill a void she doesn't even understand herself. The only place she finds happiness is with Manuel. Their chemistry is undeniable, but neither of them dares to take the step that could change their relationship; until one night, Milena's choices leave her with no option but to confront herself.

title: Aversion
overview: Follows a group of students as they overcome their phobias to survive.

title: Perception
overview: A troubled young man is pushed to his limits as he tries to find the man responsible for his girlfriend's recent disappearance. In his mission for answers, he speaks with his therapist who guides him to a horrifying discovery which changes his perception forever.

title: Family Splatters
overview: Morgan brings her new boyfriend to family dinner, but she doesn’t know what he is bringing to dinner.

title: The Daughter She Left Behind
overview: After years spent working internationally, Rachel returns home desperate to reconnect with the daughter she left behind. But when a terrifying man threatens Samantha's life, Rachel must finally become the mother she never was.

title: Mordkommission Calw - Die Hesse-Verschwörung
overview: The unsuccessful and financially troubled writer Umberto Designori discovers a historical document in the Ticino village of Montagnola. Suspecting that it was authored by the famous writer Hermann Hesse, who spent the final years of his life in Montagnola, he sets off for Calw. However, the town archivist and Hesse expert, Dr. Giebenrath, reveals to him that the document is a forgery. The following night, Designori falls to his death. The supposed Hesse letter has disappeared. Detectives Lola Kraft and Jasmin Stein of the "Mordkommission Calw" begin their investigation.

title: Airplane Store
overview: Sadie is addicted to the world of her phone, but maybe her sister can convince her to join on a trip to the airplane store?  Part of the Pens to Lens program.

title: Sisters
overview: After her elder sister Isidora attempts suicide following an argument between the two of them, eleven-year-old Petra spends the day in the hospital, hiding from a social worker. Unable to deal with the situation that has befallen her, she wanders through the corridors for hours, thinking about her relationship with her sister and about their family.

title: The Curse
overview: An archaeologist, a professor, a navigator, and a translator are all that are left from the original research team. After releasing something they never meant to, this group is hiding out, waiting to be hunted down by the very thing they released upon the world.

title: Terra Bruta
overview: In 19th-century southern Brazil, Miguel returns to the land where his story was shattered. As he confronts memories and looming threats, he advances on a journey of purification across rugged terrain and amidst ancient ghosts.

title: Fireweed Blooming
overview: In a small village far far away lives Ene. Her days pass by cleaning up after her husband and fishing at the pond. On one such day she sees that a local nymph is being abused by her partner. By saving her Ene reflects on her own life.

title: Thank You For Your Interest
overview: The story of one man's journey through unemployment and job searching. His day is full of new opportunities for his future, and brutal reminders that the path forward isn't exactly straight.

title: Try Hard
overview: Mira, a 24 year old university student tackles the pressures of Tall Poppy Syndrome (TPS) enacted by her peers at university whilst simultaneously trying to live up to the contrasting expectations of her immigrant parents. Unable to satisfy either side, Mira's internalises the conflict until it becomes too much to bear. With the support of her best friend Jess, Mira finally speaks up and regains her autonomy.

title: La Gradiva
overview: A small group of French high school students goes on a school trip to Pompeii to discover its ruins and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in 79 CE. It is in this ghost town that they are suddenly overcome by a dizzying sensation. One after another, James, Toni, Suzanne, and their Latin teacher, Mme Mercier, allow themselves to be engulfed by desire, anger, and despair—until they surrender to it completely and lose everything.

title: Everything That's Wrong With You
overview: After the emotional collapse that follows her mother’s death, Maruša builds an online bond with Alja, a nurse living in a small coastal town in Germany. Bonding through humor over their shared struggles, Maruša and Alja quickly develop a friendship that is put to the test when they finally meet in person.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: The Carry-On
overview: What haunts us is not only death, but aging. Pei-Hua is drawn like a blurred sketch—gray, undefined, embodying the quiet experience of a woman growing older.Mothers often remain fixed in place, becoming a point of reference for their daughters’ journeys. Each of us carries a “carry-on”—unfinished burdens or lessons meant to be faced in this life. When we finally leave, do these carry-ons remain? In the film, a fire becomes a ritual of release, a way of saying goodbye. Life is rarely pure joy or sorrow, and The Carry-On is no exception.

title: Garchaster's Cornblade
overview: A gricky star planet girl follows a casting call into the Earth oven so she can fulfill her dream of getting inside of a VHS tape... to burn and inhale herself. Donald Farmer weaves golden webs with the cryogenic cowboys while the star planet gets heavier with razzling trash carnivals. The Carpet Muckers twirling gorches but the Garbites are way too hungry for karaoke flavored peanut butter screams.

title: Streaming Killed the Video Store*
overview: An employee is stalked in a video store

title: We Shall Live Together
overview: Roko Markovina, a former socialist and unionist politician from the city of Mostar in Herzegovina, reflects on the situation in Croatia and Bosnia during wartime and about the fruitless efforts that he and his wife went through to get back their home that had been taken away from them by nationalist forces who exiled them from it.

title: Happy Birthday, I Guess...
overview: On her 23rd birthday, Amaia says nothing to see who remembers. Her roommates ignore her and her family lets her down. Fed up, she orders a pizza, sparking a surreal night with the only person who wishes her a happy birthday: the delivery guy.

title: CJ: A Wonderful Birthday
overview: Cedric's birthday movie.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 19 (Final)
overview: The nineteenth and final night of the tournament took place on August 16, 2026, at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, and featured the match to crown the winner of G1 Climax 36.

title: Sea of Glass
overview: 65-year-old Vangelio decides to go on holiday after her husband's death. In a run-down off-season seaside resort she meets Vicky, a young woman caring for her alcoholic father. When Vangelio protects Vicky from her father's violence, chaos erupts in their seaside town.

title: Disney Worldbuilders
overview: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

title: 2026 Disney Legends Awards Ceremony
overview: Since 1987, the Disney Legends Awards program has honored individuals for the significant impact they've had on the Disney legacy. See the 2026 honorees become Disney Legends.

title: Michelle's Mobile Medium
overview: When a hopelessly romantic spiritual medium meets her next hot catch (and client), she soon learns that this time, the story really isn't her new future with her client as much as it is his past.

title: Stay With Me
overview: On an intimate third date, Miles struggles to connect with new flame Ben as he’s plagued by ghostly visions from his past. As their passion builds, the hauntings become impossible to ignore.

title: Legazpi: And That One Philippine Island of Cunning Fools
overview: In this time-defying, satirical adaptation of Miguel López de Legazpi's archived letters, the 16th-century Spanish expedition instead encounters present-day Cebu. The same difficulties with the island’s natives lead to their decision to leave for the other Philippine islands.

title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
overview: Returning to his childhood home, Kerry and his partner Gina become trapped in a surreal reality that forces long-buried family memories to resurface.

title: Sista färden? - jakten på fyra procent
overview: The Liberals are in crisis. With dismal poll numbers, Simona Mohamsson is hitting the road to save the party. Is this the Liberals' final journey?

title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
overview: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

title: Warrior God of Exorcism
overview: The film centers on the path to immortality of Li Xuan, the former life of Tieguai Li, the leader of the Eight Immortals. It tells the fantastical story of how, during his demon-subduing endeavors, his physical body was stolen, he fell in love with the fox demon Chu Yu , but was persecuted by the Nine Nether God .

title: Sick & Twisted Tales
overview: A horror anthology featuring three short stories & a wraparound segment hosted by demented "film critics".

title: Wolfsbane
overview: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

title: Assembly Required
overview: A grieving man receives an unexpected package.

title: Simon
overview: Ulysse and Aurore are brother and sister and lives together during their college years. Rather cheerful and outgoing, Aurore tries to help her withdrawn little brother come out of his shell; he has been putting up barriers for himself since their older brother's death, a few years ago. So she takes him on a little tandem bike ride to help him let go and reconnect with her.

title: Chili Finger
overview: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

title: The Boy Who Collects Spider-Man
overview: What if Spider-Man’s most important mission wasn’t saving the city? In The Boy Who Collects Spider-Man, Spider-Man meets his biggest fan, Tim—a kid who’s collected everything about him, from his first appearance to every battle he’s ever fought. What starts as a dream come true quickly becomes something deeper as Tim begins asking real questions about power, responsibility, and what it means to be a hero, forcing Peter to open up in ways he never has before. But as the night goes on, Spider-Man realizes this isn’t just a visit—it’s a moment that matters more than anything he’s done in the suit, proving that being a hero isn’t about fighting villains or saving the world, but about showing up for someone when they need it most.

title: Desert Ed
overview: After the passing of his longtime teammate on the reality TV Show Battlebots, robot engineer Edward Robinson moves out to the desert, where he reflects on his career and adapts a new hermetic lifestyle.

title: Neighbour
overview: As student protests sweep through a deeply divided Belgrade, a police officer recognizes the young man he is beating during a violent clash. The encounter haunts him, growing into an obsession that forces him to confront the fragile line between professional duty and personal conviction.

title: The Balkan Cowboy
overview: With the help of the locals from the small town of Bijelina, artist and filmmaker Dragana Jurišić attempts to recreate the films of self-taught western director Aljoš Musli, also known as Hari Džekson

title: Identity
overview: During the Bosnian War, hundreds of ethnic Bosniak women were sent to specially designed rape camps set up by the military forces of the Republic of Srpska. Many of them had chosen to abort, however, some gave birth to these children. Now, thirty years after the traumatic events that led to their conception have taken place, three of them choose to disclose the truth of their origin and fight against the stigma many of them face in everyday life.

title: High Card
overview: When a card themed murderer lurks within the city, Detective Taylor Wilson takes upon herself to solve the case and find the killer...unless the killer already found her.

title: Heat 2
overview: The sequel to Heat - An American Original (2025).

title: 씨발 (SHIBAL)
overview: A series of mishaps befalls Tom, a printmaker with a single task: delivering a plaque to a Korean restaurant.

title: Sleeping Dreams
overview: A man sleeps to enter a world he would want to live in only to return to the world he has to live in a cycle of forced insomnia

title: How to Fast Train Your Furious Dragon
overview: The dream chasers race nitro-injected street cars and join forces with dragon rider Hiccup in the wildest cross-over ever dreamed up as 'DREAMZzz', 'The Fast and the Furious' and 'How to train your Dragon' collide head on. But the Nightmare King is always scheming and plans to corrupt the friendly dragons of Berk, and our heroes soon find themselves in a desperate race to save the Dream World.

title: The Saddest Story in the World
overview: Based on the book by Mário Corso. The story of a boy sold to the circus by his own parents.

title: Yellow Eyes
overview: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic that hosts the spirit of a powerful demon, and the wife of the man it possesses must find an exorcist to save him.

title: Leite em Pó
overview: A musician of limited talent and obsessed with rock music sees his life collapse after a devastating family loss. Alone and penniless, he takes on a new job that forces him to wander the city, where he crosses paths with a wide variety of people who challenge his worldview. Between unsettling memories and these new urban bonds, he begins an erratic and transformative journey to confront his own ghosts and try to reconnect with reality.

title: We, Brothers
overview: Two old fellow mobsters meet up at hideout to discuss their next job. They plunge into a conversation recollecting their past deeds together, which leads them into argument and rivalry, until one of them realizes something is quite wrong.

title: Amongst Men
overview: Relatives of Charles Byrne ‘The Irish Giant’ reckon with the legacy of a man both mythologised and misunderstood and the condition that links them still.

title: Motherhood
overview: From childhood onward, rules are imposed on us, behaviours are dictated to us, and we are told “how to live,” but we are never prepared for the difficulty of “being.” This film explores this question through the lens of motherhood.

title: Elephants in the Fog
overview: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

title: Back to the 90s
overview: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

title: When the Fires Stop
overview: With the local refinery closing, the town of Grangemouth is thrown into limbo.

title: Feral
overview: A feral cat is caught and her kittens are taken away to be tamed.

title: Cherry Picker
overview: An experimental documentary and quasi-autobiographical account of renting and housing precarity.

title: No Place Like Home
overview: A filmmaker revisits a childhood favourite film and finds a secret hidden inside.

title: Hidden Trees
overview: A poetic observational documentary set within the remote Scottish therapeutic community ‘Lothlorien’.

title: Cartografía
overview: An intuitive self-portrait and esoteric geographic exploration of the filmmaker's astrocartography line of Venus and Midheaven in Los Angeles, a prominent point in her birth chart for creativity and harmony.  With each version of herself comes a distinct relationship with the city and cinema, and each version shares an unavoidable fate: the passing of her grandmother.

title: Tara
overview: During a tedious train journey, Tara becomes separated from her parents and begins exploring the train cars, encountering strange creatures along the way. Without realizing it, she enters an endless labyrinth of wagons where fear and anxiety begin to haunt her. As she moves forward, Tara must confront her fears and learn how to control them a journey that Will lead her to grow and mature as a person.

title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
overview: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

title: Dogs Have No Dreams
overview: In a remote village, teenagers Ilire and Besnik hide a love forbidden by an old family debt. When Besnik enters his dog in illegal dog fights to win the money the pair is in need of, an unexpected turn forces Ilire to face the loss of the dreams they share.

title: The Great ADHD Myth?
overview: Psychiatrist Dr Max Pemberton explores the controversy surrounding attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and how it is treated.

title: B for Boys
overview: In a basement-turned boy cave, a band rehearsal spirals into chaos as creative tensions and personal drama push four teenage musicians to the brink.

title: Unwellness
overview: The rigid Ildikó is in the thick of menopause while attending an accountancy training at a spa hotel, when a hearing-impaired woman unexpectedly triggers her to rediscover her long-suppressed desire for physical intimacy.

title: I am 18 or older
overview: A conscription notice forces 20-year-old Marvin to reevaluate his life: between porn addiction, poverty, and failed intimacy, he struggles to find stability—and considers military service as a radical new beginning.

title: Fúrias
overview: Porto Alegre innovates once again: it is the first city entirely outsourced to a megacorporation, Fratel. The cutting-edge company's smart management brings technological solutions aimed at bringing more security and efficiency to the city, which serves as a test model for other capitals. Téia and Nanã, however, are left out of all this innovation: elderly, lesbian, and cyclists, they see their freedom and rights increasingly limited by the corporation's interventions. They are left with only two options: adapt or outsmart the system.

title: Speed and Battle
overview: A pair of estranged father and son are forced to team up amid a city destruction crisis triggered by drone technology, fighting against a frantic conspiracy at life-threatening speed. This is not only a race to stop disaster, but also a chance to fix their broken relationship.

title: URBANOSA
overview: Follows an urban wizard on his journey to fulfil an ancient prophecy.

title: Insecta
overview: A celebrated horror novelist returns to an isolated estate to say goodbye to her dying father, only to discover that the monstrous imaginary insect that tormented her childhood may have been real all along.

title: Little Dreamerz
overview: Gun-woo, drowning in a failing business, meets Yo-sup, a mysterious boy who lives in dreams, and glimpses a future that lets him win big on a sports bet. While searching for Yo-sup again, he crosses paths with Min-a, a guarded high school girl. Struggling to understand one another, the three are drawn into a strange journey shaped by dreams and fate.

title: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado
overview: Dora, Diego, and their new friends trek through the perilous dangers of the Amazonian jungle in search of the ancient and powerful treasure of Sol Dorado to keep it out of enemy hands.

title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault in Golden Gate Park, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

title: Water Lilies
overview: Hyo-won, who dreams of becoming an actress, arrives at Seoul city after running away from country home with Eun-seo, who dropped out of high school. They are excited with their own hopes for the future.  Hyo-won starts taking acting lessons from leading actor Su-yeon to become a member of the theater company. Eun-seo starts to work at a shabby restaurant when Hyo-won's lesson fee is urgent.  Su-yeon teaches Hyo-won. Acting... It's about fully understanding and expressing other people's pain.  But Hyo-won doesn't understand Eun-seo's pain. The same goes for Eun-seo.  Life is full of questions for them

title: Look At The Sky, Trust The Mountains
overview: A tense drama set after the Taliban takeover, following a French agent escorting an Afghan girl across a dangerous country as they form a life-changing bond.

title: When We Were Wild
overview: Once a top waterskiing prodigy, a young man alienates his three godfathers and shuts out the world after a career-ending injury. His life finds light again when he meets a mysterious girl, but his desperate need to prove his worth leads him to pawn his late father’s keepsake for a luxury car. Consumed by vanity, he allows materialism to erode their pure love, eventually driving her away. Now hitting rock bottom in a desolate reality, he must decide whether to remain in despair or find the strength to face his past and seek the redemption he so desperately needs.

title: Providence and the Guitar
overview: In a distant past, Léon and Elvira Berthelini, itinerant artists, make their living hopping from town to town. In Covarronca, harassed by the Police Commissioner, they are forced to spend the night out in the open. That’s when they meet Stubbs, a young Cambridge student, with whom they find shelter in the home of a painter at odds with his wife. In return for the hospitality, they remind their hosts that the love of art resolves the art of love. Meanwhile, an unusual curse sends them on absurd journeys into the 21st century, where the future of social security and of a rock band are at stake.

title: Think Good
overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

title: Fools of Nature
overview: On the first night of an impromptu journey out of New York City, Malcolm and Jamie trek through New Jersey, eventually stopping to stay the night at a motel. As the night moves along, the two friends are forced to confront their relationship head-on, changing the course of their relationship forever.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry
overview: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

title: Be with You
overview: A high school dropout and delinquent, Jie, falls in love with a quiet, speech-impaired high school girl, Guang, leading to a story of mutual growth and healing.

title: V
overview: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

title: Hidden Love
overview: Sang Zhi quietly falls for Duan Jiaxu, her older brother’s college roommate. Years later, a chance reunion allows their once-hidden feelings to resurface, gradually turning an unspoken crush into a heartfelt romance.

title: Just Friends
overview: Returning to her hometown, Masha meets Pasha, whom she hasn't seen for many years. Together they overcome the death of a beloved one thus coming closer to each other. But their lives, full of dreams and losses, are rather different and drive them apart again and again. Each meeting brings back the old spark, but neither can decide to anything more. Through trauma and failure,they mature, learn to love, and try to figure out who they are to each other.

title: Party Princess
overview: Isabela, an undocumented street artist in princess garb, comes across a lost toddler on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, but time is pressing, and her immigration lawyer is waiting with a vital deadline.

title: dAIsy
overview: An emotionally adaptive superintelligence marketed to elevate its owners' lives forges a powerful bond with an overwhelmed couple, transforming their world until her judgment forces them to confront how much control they are willing to surrender.

title: HB2ME
overview: A seemingly ordinary birthday celebration quickly spirals into chaos.

title: Patch
overview: Iva fights a loosing battle against her abusive mother who tries her hardest to control every aspect of the former's life. The way she sees it, there's only one way out of her continously deteriorating mental state: running.

title: El canto de los pajaros
overview: In the drowsiness between sleep and wakefulness, the birds sing. The river forms a border yet also unites; it is a bridge shaped like a 3D dream, where the Río de la Plata wetlands meet the shores of Gaza.

title: Vado in America
overview: A documentary and investigative essay on the traces of migration, family memory, and the audiovisual archive connecting the experience between Switzerland and Argentina.

title: Жизнь после смерти
overview: This funny and tragic film explores the struggle to cope with the death of someone close to you. The main character, Tolya, who has just entered university, is confronted with the death of his mother from cancer and unexpectedly shoulders the responsibility of organizing the funeral: obtaining a death certificate, choosing a coffin and cemetery plot, calling relatives, and meeting his long-lost father. Irony becomes Tolya's only way to cope, so the characters and the world around them transform into grotesque versions of themselves: a nurse-bartender, a sinister cross seller, and an army of ninjas. But behind every humorous detail lies genuine pain.

title: Как мы деда провожали
overview: A funeral bus gets stuck in the snow-covered vast expanses on the way to the cemetery. Instead of solving the problem, family members sort things out with each other. The family is falling apart before our eyes, and only the deceased grandfather will help save it.

title: СВОП
overview: The wedding has fallen through, and the bride heads from the registry office to the flea market to exchange her wedding dress for something better.

title: Сухой завтрак
overview: The story of a lonely diner cleaner, hiding from the world behind the ridiculous guise of an old man, who one day finds a video game cartridge in a cereal box that opens the door to a world of forgotten youth, where the boundaries between past memories, fantasy and reality begin to gradually blur.

title: Цепенеющий лох
overview: At a provincial film festival, a young director who unexpectedly wins the top prize spends one absurd night with his friends. While everyone around him is discussing the award, drinking, falling in love, arguing about the coolness of the Husky, waking up the plane, the main character gradually understands that the real value of this night is not the victory or the movie, but random intimacy with a person.

title: Lizzzard
overview: Two teenage girls push the limits of their sleepy suburban world during one jagged night in 2008.

title: Plötzlich Schwiegervater
overview: Paul Hagedorn’s beloved daughter, Annette, wants to get married. But from the very first moment, Hagedorn and his future son-in-law, Joe, can’t stand each other. Their first meeting ends in a physical altercation that leads to legal consequences. What begins as a personal conflict quickly escalates into a bitter power struggle between the two men, leaving Annette caught in the middle…

title: Porkatal
overview: On his sixth birthday, Engin is separated from his mother, with whom he has lived in prison since his birth. Taken in by his grandparents, the boy struggles to adapt to the harsh realities of life in their village while working out a plan to reunite with his mother.

title: Le chemin de la victoire - Nous c'est carré !
Hominid
overview: A lonesome caveman encounters a strange tribe on his quest for food.

title: Where Is Your Faith
overview: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

title: Idiots
overview: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

title: Born in the Jungle
overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.

title: Khalifa: The Ruler
overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

title: Mutiny
overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

title: Insidious: Out of the Further
overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

title: Estrelando Marta
overview: Marta dreams of starting her acting career.

title: Rinrada the Influencer
overview: When a female influencer is destroyed by social media backlash to the point of taking her own life, she gets a second chance as a spirit with only 28 days before she is forgotten forever.

title: Tony
overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: Czech Girl
overview: Widowed Zdena lives a quiet life as a postwoman in a small Czech village. When her beloved son Lukas returns home from France to say goodbye to his dying grandmother, his determination to make her seemingly impossible wish come true leads him to reveal a secret that challenges the values of the village: his queer life in Paris and his drag queen alter ego, Chica Checa.

title: Spa Weekend
overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

title: Goodbye Cruel World
overview: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

title: A Stroll to Syracuse
overview: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

title: Ice Skater
overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

title: Mundurukuyü – The Forest of the Fish Women
overview: Using the camera as a weapon to defend their ancestral land in Brazil, three women of the Daje Kapap Eypi audiovisual collective lovingly record their Munduruku traditions and their mythology of humans transforming into forest plants and animals.

title: Harusnya Horror
overview: For the sake of being able to watch the last episode of his favorite anime that appeared exactly before his sudden death, a shy anime-obsessed ghost is forced to accept a task from the afterlife to haunt 100 thousand humans. The problem? He's more terrified of people than they are of him. So, to achieve his goal, he reluctantly becomes the "star talent" for a crew of broke, fraudulent horror creators, which in the end forces him to choose between his personal ambition or saving the only 'family' he has ever found.

title: The Raffle of Julinho the Pig
overview: A traditional soccer club seeks to adapt to hardships and raise funds through an unusual strategy: raffling off a pig. However, what seemed like merely an odd tale turns into a police matter when allegations arise that the animal was stolen. As the story gains traction, Julinho the Pig becomes a celebrity while awaiting the resolution of his fate.

title: Red Rue Express
overview: A romantic comedy that modernizes and reimagines one of the most famous and vivid Ukrainian national symbols, Chervona Ruta, and turns it into a new cultural phenomenon.

title: Il n'y aura jamais assez d'images
Dan Bandung
overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

title: Совок
overview: Vyacheslav Ermakov, a phony businessman and life-waster, owes a large sum to a crime boss and, to pay off his debt, is forced to agree to carry out his errand. But a fateful encounter occurs along the way. To survive, Slava must play a survival game. The film is unusual in the ambiguity of its antagonist and his motives, all set against the backdrop of class conflict and reflection on the collapse of the USSR.

title: Amnesty 1979
overview: In Rome, in June 1979, the International Conference for Amnesty in Brazil is filmed, a major gathering of the Brazilian left in exile. Viewed in the present day, this archive revisits with rare vitality the question of political strategies in the face of state repressive apparatuses.

title: The Lights, They Fall
overview: Sixteen-year-old Ilay drifts through the summer on the outskirts of Berlin while a palliative nurse accompanies his ailing mother during her last days.

title: Kuncen
overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Тоже мне любовь
overview: Anya (33) organizes a bachelorette party for her younger sister Lina (25), who is about to marry her fiancé Omkar. While trying to make the evening special, Anya finds herself quietly unsettled by the upcoming wedding and the dynamics of Lina’s relationship. As the night unfolds and the celebration grows increasingly chaotic, Anya’s attempts to control the situation begin to spiral, forcing both sisters to confront difficult questions about love, expectations, and the choices they make.

title: Elisa and the letter
overview: Elisa leads her friend Leonora into an art studio. While her friend acts like an ill-at-ease guest, Elisa navigates the chaotic space with ease and, amid the paintings and the hidden corners, uncovers a stack of love letters with no addressee. Fascinated, the two friends begin to recite them, unaware that those words hide a secret involving one of them.

title: MACDUFF'D
overview: By the pricking of thy thumbs.

title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

title: Hiddensee
overview: Hiddensee in the Baltic Sea has always been a place where people have sought freedom. This film takes us on a journey through an entire century, starting in the golden 1920s, as it assembles the island’s scenery, history, and personal stories into a fascinating portrait. Then as now, the political upheavals that have swept across Germany have left their mark.

title: Tape 001
overview: Following the discovery of a mysterious tape, a young man dives deep into the dark secrets of a mysterious video game company and the creature they made.

title: Don't Politicize
overview: In the northern region of Hungary, the populist propaganda of Orbán’s regime dictates the lives of military high school student Luca and her friends. But how do you distinguish between the opinions imposed on you and your own intrinsic beliefs in the most forming period of your life?

title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
overview: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

title: Reventar
overview: Pablo and Perí have a plan, but first, Perí must talk to Matilde.

title: Good Dad
overview: Teenager Sasha witnesses a kidnapping, setting off a chain of events that could destroy his family.

title: Девочки танцуют
overview: Yulia, a young go-go dancer, loses her job after suffering a seizure during a performance, and her mother, Irina, becomes the victim of a scam. Yulia doesn't despair and quickly finds a job at a new nightclub.

title: Зеркальная звезда
overview: An aspiring director arrives in the Moscow region to film a documentary about a legendary Counter-Strike coach. However, instead of an esports legend, she's met by a forty-year-old security guard who doesn't own a computer, and whose training methods only fit on a couple of notebook pages. To save the project, the director decides to turn the charlatan coach into a youth icon, uncovering who's really deceiving whom.

title: Twix
overview: Close friends decide to make fun of a "rich" schoolboy, taking advantage of his advances, but begin competing for his attention, even to the point of smearing chocolate on his face.

title: Тихий свет
overview: Sister and brother meet at their parents' old dacha after many years of mutual silence.

title: Штраф
overview: Young traffic police officer Artyom, trying to hide his relationship with his boss's daughter, runs away from the girl's apartment and gets into a freak accident. After fleeing the scene, he confronts the owner of the Volga he dented, a principled retiree, in his office. His futile attempts to evade justice deprive Artyom of everything, but they lead him to the most important thing: the ability to take responsibility for his actions.

title: Ты ещё придёшь?
overview: Arina works as a children's entertainer, but is forced to combine this with the rigorous work of debt collection. Faced with unfair and cruel treatment of a child, Arina hopes to make things right with her ability to bring joy, but her illusion is shattered by harsh reality.

title: Я всё реже слышу твой голос
overview: The last days of summer. Between friendship, love, and impending changes, Lera becomes increasingly lost in her own feelings. As time passes, only fragments of memories remain of this summer.

title: The Fighter
overview: He fights fighters who use their signature move, but refuses to use it first. She doesn't engage in combat at all—until he's defeated. And then one day she'll have to defend herself.

title: Be My Friend
overview: Pasha, who has trouble making decisions, comes to his couple of friends to share important career news, but instead of support, he faces the worst possible choice: deciding which of them he will stay with after they break up.

title: The Clinic
overview: The Clinic is a documentary exploring the emotional realities of veterinary work through the perspectives of vets, vet nurses and vet techs. Following the care of Katy, a cat brought to the clinic by a rescue agency, the film looks at the compassion, connection and emotional strain that comes with caring for animals, while highlighting the often-overlooked impact of compassion fatigue on veterinary professionals.

title: Adrenalina
overview: A doctor who hides a criminal compulsion.

title: Combustion
overview: After a chance encounter with an arsonist, an isolated young woman begins to unravel the mystery of his identity.

title: Missing Biscuit
