overview: When Claire’s taxidermied dog vanishes mid-meal, she grills her guests, unearthing secrets, slabs, and a strong appetite for chaos.

title: Danse Macabre
overview: Two mates arrive at a silent disco party in the suburbs, soon finding sinister forces taking over their estranged friend.

title: IPPON
overview: For Alejandro, judo is more than just a sport: it’s a chance to represent Costa Rica at the Olympic Games. As he trains to face his rivals on the mat, he must also deal with a lack of financial support and personal struggles that threaten to derail his journey. Amid sacrifices, uncertainty, and perseverance, his struggle goes beyond the sport.

title: El método
overview: A struggling actor is cast to play a legendary film star and must isolate himself in the actor's mansion to undergo an extreme method-acting process. As he digs into the role, he uncovers clues surrounding a mysterious death-forcing him to question the man he is becoming and how far he's willing to go to expose the truth.

title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK: Rewind
overview: Hosted by international Drag Race aficionado Angeria Paris VanMicheals, RuPaul’s Drag Race UK: Rewind takes a hilarious trip down memory lane to revisit some of the most unforgettable moments from seven seasons of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK and three seasons of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK vs The World. From iconic runway looks and legendary performances to outrageous comedy, unforgettable drama and the queens who snatched the crown, celebrate the very best of Drag Race UK — before a brand-new season begins.

title: Marbles
overview: After the death of her father’s best friend, Elisa starts feeling an even greater distance between them than the one she already felt.

title: Goytacaz: The Movie
overview: When the board shuts down operations for the first time in 112 years and announces the sale of the "Aryzão," Goytacaz fans rise up and risk their lives to save the last soccer stadium in Campos. Within a few months, a grassroots movement secures victories at the City Council and the Historical Heritage Council, launching the rebuilding of Goytacaz from scratch with the involvement of a young armless player. What does this story reveal about Campos?

title: Hot Spot
overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: Billy Knight
overview: After losing his father, Alex discovers a box of unfinished scripts and a handkerchief with the name “Billy Knight” embroidered on it. Consumed with the desire to discover his identity, Alex embarks on a Hollywood adventure to track down this mysterious and reclusive Billy Knight.

title: Paper Flowers
overview: Based on a true story, USC graduate Shalin Shah leaves behind the expectations of his Indian-American family and his girlfriend Fiona to serve as a Peace Corps volunteer in Peru. But when a persistent cough leads to a devastating diagnosis of synovial sarcoma, a rare and aggressive cancer, Shalin is forced to return home and confront a future he never anticipated. Surrounded by his family, Fiona, and his closest friends, he begins to reconsider what it means to live with purpose when time can no longer be taken for granted. As Shalin’s perspective deepens, his reflections on gratitude, love, and mortality inspire the essay “Thank You, Cancer,” which is published by HuffPost and goes viral with readers around the world. A devastatingly beautiful story of family, resilience, and the lasting impact of one life, Paper Flowers is a reminder to cherish the people we love and the moments that give life meaning. #SunsetsForShalin

title: If I Tell You
overview: IF I TELL YOU uncovers a family’s pressing secret while the 12-year-old son finds his voice and the courage to stand up for what is right.

title: El Búnker
overview: After several years of silence of the LGBTIQ+ community because of a national decree, a group of friends organized a big attack to be free and have the right to speak in public again.

title: Irumudi
overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

title: The Snare
overview: When a high school student is arrested with a small amount of drugs, the police pressure her to become an informant—forcing her to choose between the people she most loves and the future she's worked so hard to create.

title: The King of Horror
overview: A young director is obsessed with casting a long-lost coursemate in a horror film — the one who vanished after a disturbing incident they both swore to forget.

title: The Sun Never Sets
overview: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

title: Atlas King
overview: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

title: Soul Trader
overview: A despondent soul arrives in a strange place where he must confront his (mostly) inner demons.

title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
overview: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

title: The House
overview: After a heart attack, Jovan, a retired architect of Serbian origin who spent most of his life in Germany, refuses to give into his daughter's pressure to spend the rest of his life in a nursing home. With his grandson Nikola, who has Asperger's syndrome and is living without social contacts, he travels to his homeland, a village in Serbia, to sell the family land, but becomes a part of a local population rebellion against the construction mafia that threatens to destroy everything that is left of his homeland.

title: Ram and Leela
overview: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: My Armor
overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

title: Facing El Chapo
overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

title: Clarissa
overview: A modern reimagining of the Virginia Woolf novel Mrs. Dalloway. Follows society woman Clarissa as she prepares to host a party at her home in Lagos, Nigeria, where she will unexpectedly encounter once-intimate friends from her youth. As the group reflects on their shared past over the course of a single night, memories of their intricate relationships, passionate love, hidden desires, and lost aspirations give rise to bittersweet reckoning.

title: Zero Meets Hero
overview: War veteran Mr Thoi and his Gen Z grandson Tri Binh embark on a comedic journey to reunite with old war comrades, weaving together Vietnamese spiritual beliefs and generational bonds.

title: Kadhal Aura
overview: Two men with opposite beliefs about love and God are cursed to swap souls, forcing them to live each other's lives and face the women they love.

title: Grip
overview: In a remote Russian village, young paramedic Alisa has just married and dreams of the life ahead. But everything changes when her husband Anton is suddenly called up.

title: Soap Fever
overview: With the Soviet Union’s dissolution dragging down the economy of neighboring Finland, the Scandinavian country was plunged in a period of protracted recession. And with no recovery in sight, a soap opera offered Finns a respite from the grim reality; the debut of The Bold and the Beautiful on television quickly amassed a vast and dedicated following, whereas the arrival of American idols in the country, on tour, elicited unprecedented frenzy.

title: Judaa
overview: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

title: Tokyo MER: Mobile Emergency Room - Capital Crisis
SHIRANUI
overview: Summer 1996 – Minato, a 10-year-old boy, is neglected by his alcoholic father and keeps to himself at home in a town by the sea. His only source of solace is Ben-chan, a girl goddess that appears on Benten Island. As Minato faces a new life in an orphanage and a painful parting from Ben-chan, he makes a wish to Shiranui for her. However, growing hatred toward his father gradually turns the wish into a malicious "curse" against him…

title: Peppermint Pixie Dream Girl
overview: A ditzy waitress named Shirley May Holmes falls head-over-heels for Dorothy, a peppermint-clad pinup girl, but she has much to conquer if she wants to land a kiss from Dorothy's candy lips. Transphobic greasers, hetero-nonsense, and the nuclear blast itself will all come crashing down upon Shirley on this pivotal night... She may just need a little help to make it to sunrise alive.

title: Ordinary
overview: A pair of mismatched twins wait for a deal to start their own Legend.

title: Modha Rathri
overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

title: Inte Ett Riktigt Jobb
overview: How can an entire career in the cultural sector not count? The Minister of Education has announced that one-third of the funding for adult education associations is to be cut, with the money instead being invested in educational programs that lead to “real jobs.” What happens to the next generation of creators? And what do we lose as a society when the pathways into the cultural sector become increasingly scarce?

title: They Will Remember My Name
overview: An out of work child actor finds himself in hot water in a last-ditch effort to revitalize his career.

title: CRAYON SHIN-CHAN THE MOVIE: SPOOKY! MY YOKAI VACATION
Never Stop Chasing
overview: A documentary portrait of storm chaser Reed Timmer, who was an inspiration for Glen Powell’s character in Twisters.

title: Major Bag Alert
overview: 2005. Gossip around the school is that 16-year-old Janina's family is having serious financial troubles. Janina and her group of friends plan to prove the rumours wrong by stealing an expensive handbag from the neighbourhood shopping centre.

title: Mixed Sauna
overview: Introvert Mikko is anxious that he won’t be able to come out of his shell during the weekend at his relatively new spouse’s cottage. His spouse Hanna is certain that Mikko will make a great first impression on her chosen family, the three friends that they are hosting.  When it’s time for the sauna Mikko has not, despite all his attempts, figured out the sauna dress code of this new social bubble. As he steps into the sauna, Mikko realizes he’s the only one wearing swimwear—everybody else is naked. This traumatising event causes mixed emotions which Mikko is unable to shake away. Mikko tries to come out of his shell with his own way but everything ends up going even worse.

title: i am not from here
overview: A three-headed Melbourne set reality film about art, dilectics, and regionality.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: Ikenga: The Last Festival
overview: In the peaceful kingdom of Umuani, where honor, integrity, and sacred traditions guide the people, the use of dark spiritual forces is strongly condemned. But when a powerful man rises through forbidden powers and tests the resolve of the entire kingdom, the very foundation of their way of life is threatened. As the people suffer under his influence, the king and elders come under immense pressure to restore honor and preserve their sacred traditions.

title: ROH: Death Before Dishonor 2026
overview: The 2026 Death Before Dishonor was an professional wrestling live streaming event produced by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH). It was the 23rd Death Before Dishonor event and took place on Friday, August 21, 2026, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The show was broadcast on both HonorClub and MyAEW (for international subscribers).

title: Ё
overview: The place of the letter Ё in the Russian language intrigues a young writer named Roman, and he decides to dedicate his first book to it. Work progresses slowly, as Roman is hampered by work, household chores, and a lack of time in the day. One day, clones appear in his life, ready to take on all his chores and responsibilities, just so he can write. At first, everything goes well, but over time, the relationship between Roman and the clones frays, as everyone vie for the writer's place.

title: Всплеск
overview: Lilya and Tema are lying in a tent by the river. Lilya hears a splash and asks Tema to check if anyone is outside. There's no one around—it seems Lilya was mistaken.

title: Above
overview: While adults live in a world of fear, compromise, and prohibitions, the boy helps the old man realize his last dream and reminds those around him that it is the ability to dream that makes a person human.

title: Captive
overview: After a group of friends is abducted, they find themselves as the unwilling participants of a violent live stream: one that's impossible to trace and impossible to stop. CAPTIVE is based on real internet crimes and uses multi POV to put the viewer inside their harrowing journey, bringing them face to face with evil.

title: Sweet Nothing
overview: As Jack Bledsoe embarks on a journey to find and book a Drag Queen, his internalized homophobia begins to unravel his relationship with his partner and with himself.

title: Ballonfieber
overview: Christin, a successful district judge, had long since given up on love, until a hot-air-balloon pilot named Max enters her life. What begins as a fleeting encounter develops into a tender, surprising connection: Christin has chosen to live alone, in the reliable company of her chatbot Hermann, but now Max is turning her structured world upside down. Although the single father is the same age as Christin’s daughter Miriam, he doesn’t fall in love with her—he falls in love with Christin.

title: More Lovely
overview: A young woman journals about love characterized by three couples.

title: Ferenju Habesha
overview: New romance movie

title: Imperfection
overview: A product of listening, rather than acting. Fireworks and the aquarium.

title: My Husband's Sister
overview: A reformed con artist's second chance at love is threatened when a murderous caregiver from his past resurfaces.

title: Gladiator Baby
overview: A young girl and a young boy must fight for their goals to pave the way for their dreams — but only one of them can get closer to their destination, and only if they are willing to destroy the other’s dream in the gamble of ambition.

title: Settlement
overview: While enjoying nature, four friends encounter something definitely unnatural.

title: A Father's Secret
overview: Follows a resilient woman who built a stable life after years of hardship, only for her world to be threatened by the sudden return of her father after a 10-year disappearance.

title: Detective
overview: A detective returns to the crime scene that continuously haunts him, only to come face to face with his true culprit.

title: Hunting Trip
overview: Out on a hunting trip, a father and son lie prone atop a hill. Their long wait for the perfect shot becomes a chance for the father to connect with his son and impart valuable lessons that he will need for the rest of his life.

title: Piyak Oskân
overview: Piyak Oskân, meaning "family" in Michif, tells the story of Rose, a Métis woman who grows up and falls in love in her Road Allowance community. However, the Saskatchewan government imposes strict conditions on her family, drastically changing their lives.

title: A Good Samaritan
overview: A Detective tracks down a killer of homeless people on the streets of Detroit.

title: Zhalin
overview: A female university student arrives late at night at her dormitory and finds herself locked out. She is forced to make her way across the city to her aunt's house, where she encounters a mysterious man along the way.

title: Bosco: La Sombra Extraviada Bajo la Luna de Plata
pages.
overview: At a quiet city bus stop, a forgotten book becomes the silent witness to the passing moments, choices, and connections of those who come and go.

title: Finish The Booze
overview: Using photos taken on a dominoes game and one music by the artist Pepe Moreno, the short film is an observational and ironic documentary that shows the transformation of the participants and the chaos that ensues when there is excessive alcohol consumption. A comical and realistic reflection on the excesses and affections that mark the encounters of Brazilian male youth, all to the sound of the electronic forró genre.

title: A Mighty Adventure
overview: Three little insects are transported to a concrete city. A series of extraordinary micro-adventures forces them to explore themselves and helps to build their self-esteem, so they can finally get back home. They become much stronger and happier, are able to choose their own future.

title: Bo-bo
overview: Nadya was born with a pathology. She has a large red-burgundy hemangioma on her small face. In the native village Nadya faces the hostility and ridicule of others, furthermore her own family does not accept the girl as she is. Nadya grandmother tries to treat her illness with all religious methods she knows, while Nadya mother constantly dreams of a surgical operation in Moscow. Nadya just wants to be herself. Her only wish is to sing in the choir. After getting into another mess, she ends up in a Moscow hospital, where meets people like her. But even after the physical problem has been resolved nothing changes in her family life.

title: Antar Nada
overview: Hana is a middle school girl who once had a deep interest in music who is reluctantly paired with her classmate, Nada, for a school assignment. Nada, too, once had a gift for music, but it has gradually faded as she slowly loses her hearing due to an illness she suffers from. Her limitations in communication make their relationship increasingly awkward and distant, until a piano opens up a new way for them to understand each other without words.

title: Ani
overview: In an alternate reality, a struggling farmer's principles are tested when a powerful trader manipulates him to compete against his co-farmers.

title: YEG: A Turkic Folktale
overview: A desperate father prays to Tengri to save his sick son. When a mysterious stranger arrives with dark tales of ancient Turkic dragons, fear, madness, and curses consume the family, leading them toward a bloody and tragic fate.

title: The Andersons
overview: The Andersons is a satirical horror film that begins as a cheerful VHS-era sitcom, following a picture-perfect suburban family. Laugh tracks cue every joke, routines repeat flawlessly, and nothing ever truly changes. That is, until Lisa, the mother, begins to notice something is wrong. Jokes repeat word for word, objects reset, the world seems to glitch, and an unseen audience appears to be watching her every move.  As the cracks begin to show, Lisa steps beyond the sitcom stage and into a void where the making of the show is revealed: cameras, crew, and the presence of an audience. Desperate to escape, she fights her way back into the “show,” only to find the family reset, everyone frozen in their roles while the laughter never stops.  Trapped in an endless loop of artificial happiness, Lisa is left alone with the terrifying realization that awareness is the worst punishment of all.

title: Love Finds You
overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

title: Somero
overview: The Four Seasons - part one: Two strangers are brought together during a lock-down, in the wake of a world changing natural event.

title: May You Have a Good Day
overview: After his father passes away, a man returns to a soon-to-be-demolished Aerotropolis community to sort through unfinished documentary footage and remnants of a life once lived. The fractured bond between father and son remains unresolved. As the roar of airplanes echoes through the emptied neighborhood, his days lose direction. One night, an uninvited spirit that cannot be driven away enters his home.

title: Two Still
overview: Hao Hao and Xi Xi each said goodbye to their exes and fell in love with each other. Like most couples, they argued during their relationship, but the storm would pass and things would clear up... When it came time to get married, they began to seriously consider whether they were suitable for each other. After all, like socks, they needed to be in pairs to go on together. Could mismatched socks be suitable to be together...?

title: When We Talk About Grape What We Talk About
overview: Late at night, a rideshare driver picks up a passenger and realizes she is his former lover. As the car moves through the city, silence and buried memories surface. In the short ride ahead, they must face what was left unsaid—and the lives they never had together.

title: Scorch Marks
overview: Waking up to a scorched sky, Beckett fears he is the lone survivor of a sudden global catastrophe. Stranded and isolated inside a seaside rental property, his remaining grip on reality rapidly unravels when he is confronted by a terrifying presence—the vengeful spirit of Joel, his abusive ex-husband. To survive both the unfolding global apocalypse and the primordial forces awakening around them, the estranged pair must directly confront the toxic, destructive history of their past life within high society.

title: Buried in the Snow
overview: The world above ground and the world below.  Below the horizon, there exists a world that belongs neither to the present, future, nor past, surrounded by boulders and waterfalls, where departed life secretly continues its activities. The spirits of those atomic life forms flow in the meandering water, formless yet remembering the past.  Above the horizon, all things that continue to live continue to live. A gust of wind blows, a flurry of snow falls, waiting for winter to pass, waiting for the sun to rise. Memory, like a giant tendril, rises from the ground, its roots seeping into the soil with the melting snow.  Having been here, yet never truly here.  This is a film poem commemorating the passing of a dear friend from my youth. The poem was hand-engraved on a 400-foot-long roll of film.​

title: Beautiful Girl
overview: "I'll be home soon," Cece said.  On a rainy cold evening, Mai, a Vietnamese grandmother with dementia, is left home alone.

title: Limbo
overview: After my father’s death, I visit his house one last time. It is about to be demolished. I walk through it, searching the debris for traces of his memory. I find a few forgotten objects in the empty rooms. I am alone, and there is an echo. I speak aloud to silence the ghosts—or the absence. Finally, I come across a shared memory.

title: It Pays to Belong
overview: A documentary about The Embassy, the iconic duo at the heart of Gothenburg's influential indie scene that emerged in the early 2000s.

title: Slogans (Part Two)
overview: "Orientation"

title: anywhere
overview: In early 2000s rural America, an introspective high school senior tries to finish a scholarship essay that will determine the next four years- or maybe the rest of her life.

title: Акустика
overview: In a science town near Moscow, a cashier from Dikson is trying to win back his love—the cashier from Pyaterochka. His former classmate, who conveniently wandered into the late-night supermarket, helps him.

title: Алоха!
overview: Eduard is a lonely, terminally ill man in the final stages of cirrhosis. His life changes dramatically when he meets a delivery robot named Aloha. This chance night, full of sadness and unexpected friendship, becomes Eduard's final journey into himself, toward forgiveness and reconciliation with those he lost.

title: Мама просила не взрывать метеорит
overview: Ten-year-old Tyoma befriends a fallen meteorite that wanders the streets, wreaking havoc on the locals. Only Tyoma knows the true reason for this behavior—the meteorite is searching for its fragments. Trying to save his friend from destruction, he must convince his father to believe in miracles.

title: Psyche
overview: The psychotherapist faces a personal crisis due to his involvement in the relationship with the client.

title: Threefold
overview: Scarlette is a firm believer in Karma, and a fun night out on the town is ruined when she catches her mortal enemy with her ex-boyfriend. This sends her into a manic spiral. At this point, Scarlette is gifted a book of black magic and a switch goes off. With the powers that the book holds, Scarlette discovers that revenge is far more satisfying than forgiveness.

title: The Babysitter’s Double Life
overview: A College Student begins an affair with a wealthy man who inspires her to create a babysitting-adjacent service for lonely, divorced fathers. However, things soon get dangerous as the operation grows into a full prostitution ring under her name.

title: Lucha
overview: Trapped in the monotony of his office job, a disillusioned accountant begins to imagine himself as a masked luchador locked in a brutal wrestling match.

title: UWAK
overview: A homeless man who survives by pretending to be disabled discovers a mysterious piece of paper that leads him into an unsettling encounter.

title: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only Live
overview: Experience Sam Reid's electrifying live performance from the premiere event of Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat at NYC's Beacon Theatre, featuring original songs by series composer Daniel Hart.

title: The Groundhog's Nightmare
overview: A man wakes up to the same day over and over again. Is he trapped in time, or trapped within himself?

title: The Ferry Man: The Dream of the Celestial Maiden
The Ferry Man: Butterfly Dream
overview: The tranquility of a remote mountain village was suddenly shattered when children began to disappear one by one. The villagers blamed the mysterious Mountain God for the children's disappearances.

title: Marguerite - Live at Cabaret Vert
overview: Marguerite brings a fresh and emotional take on modern French pop to Cabaret Vert 2026. Her performance blends catchy melodies, folk touches and British-inspired guitar sounds. Songs such as “Les Filles, les Meufs” explore identity, bisexuality, vulnerability and personal growth. On stage, she combines sensitivity and honesty with a playful, confident presence. Recorded on August 22, 2026, the ARTE Concert captures a rising French artist at a pivotal moment in her career.

title: Moon River
overview: In the Amazon, Fábio and Igor experience a territory of discovery during their youth. This journey is interrupted by the departure of Fábio to another city. Twenty years later they meet again and, between memories and silences, they realize that they no longer remember the territory they once lived, only the fragmented and constantly shifting sentimental map, like the waters of the Benfica River.

title: Nihilo
overview: A woman carrying a hammer stumbles upon a mysterious door in the middle of nowhere. Now she must find a way to open it or live with the uncertainty of what might lie on the other side.

title: Roadkill
overview: A boy has a dream about trick-or-treating in July.

title: Jwala
overview: A kidnapping reignites a decades-old blood feud, forcing a retired underworld figure and the men seeking vengeance against him into a brutal collision where no one is truly innocent.

title: Love?
overview: A documentary about love. Filmed in Sicily, Italy. Filmmaker Boston B. interviews three people from around the world, Mexico, Ireland, and Italy, to see where they stand with love and how it affects them, from the magical to the grounded. He asks three questions: do you believe in true love, love at first sight, and the idea of "the one".

title: Die Otissee
overview: The extraordinary journey of Otis Seuss.

title: Crude Awakenings
overview: At a ruthless PR firm, an ambitious publicist takes on a notorious energy company at the promise of a promotion. As a mysterious sickness spreads throughout her firm, she must decide whether to sacrifice her morals in favour of corporate success.

title: The Eyes
overview: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

title: Boris Is Dead
overview: A struggling actor, working as a waiter, unwittingly becomes involved in a violent heist gone wrong, where his boss—deep in debt—has been stealing from employees and running the restaurant as a front for the mob.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: False Advertising
overview: A job interview becomes a negotiation over identity.

title: Keep Fit!
overview: An awkward and intrusive teenager armed with reports, presentations, and practical exercises literally pulls the teacher out of the noose—first with his tediousness, then with his absurdly persistent determination. Gradually, a strange game develops between them: from passing requirements and “fun starts” to an unexpected friendly closeness that temporarily restores both of their taste for life.

title: Solus
overview: When unknown entities descend upon Earth, a recluse must navigate the consequences of their choices and society's fall.

title: Love on the Needle Tip
overview: Teacher Lee suddenly dies during a sex party, and the toxicology reports reveal multiple illicit substances in his system, leading police to suspect a fatal overdose. But with countless partygoers entering and leaving his room that night—including a hookup arranged through an app, the drug dealer who supplied the substances, a famous adult influencer, and even his husband, who stayed by his side throughout the night—everyone becomes a suspect. Who is actually responsible for his death?

title: Only Bears
overview: Over the course of one wildly unpredictable day, two married bears attempt to rekindle their intimacy—but between traffic, screenings, queer social chaos, and a stranger handing them gently used pizza, life keeps acting like the pushy “third” in their relationship

title: Принцесса
overview: Ira is an artist. She lives with her daughter in a shared apartment. Despite her modest circumstances, Ira creates a world for the girl where she feels like a princess. Ira gets a chance to prove herself at a publishing house, but loses the job following a surprise inspection by child protective services. At home, she continues to foster a sense of wonder for her daughter. And the miracle happens: sketches she had found make their mark, and Ira gets another chance.

title: Ночёвка
overview: Two elderly friends plan their own funerals in an attempt to conquer their fear of death, but instead find themselves feeling alive again.

title: Дороги судоку
overview: One morning, Yana discovers that her domineering grandmother has transferred money to scammers and a colleague has framed her in front of her boss. To make matters worse, her grandmother continues to trust the scammers more than her own granddaughter. In a single day, Yana must find a way to save her job and her sense of self without destroying her relationship with her grandmother.

title: Blohaj
overview: 20 years ago, corporations erased the sea from all maps and sealed off the cities. A young architect steals crypto to survive - and discovers the sea is ten minutes away, past a forgotten border.

title: Бабки
overview: A father and son live in the same apartment, yet each leads his own parallel life. Matters come to a head when the son decides to leave home…

title: TNA Lockdown 2026
overview: The 2026 Lockdown is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on Sunday, August 23, 2026, at Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It will be the 13th event under the Lockdown chronology. This event will be the first Lockdown since 2016 and the first to be held as a pay-per-view event since 2014. The event's central theme is that the entire card is contested inside a steel cage. Beyond standard cage matches, the event frequently features specialized variations, most notably the signature Lethal Lockdown match.

title: Kvinnan i gruvhålet
overview: A woman survives against all odds after being thrown down a mine shaft. A story of violence, survival, and the pursuit of justice.

title: The Ninth Layer
overview: In the north-west of China during the Republic of China era, a mysterious case was discovered in Fengyang Town, Qianzhou. The haunting incidents had everyone on edge, and the strange death of a tomb robber made the already hard-to-distinguish case even more confusing. Two detectives came to investigate the case. From then on, the hunt began with constant twists and turns. The drama of the mantis catching the cicada while the oriole waited behind unfolded one layer after another. No one could tell who the hunter and the prey were until the ninth level.

title: Beyond the Vote
overview: LAs divisions deepen across America, relational organizers mobilize 145 North Carolinians to engage millions of Black voters in Eastern North Carolina, reclaiming "woke" as a call to action to build sustainable community power.

title: The Happiest Day of My Life
overview: In 1982, 10-year-old Vasco lives with his mom in a small town. He's obsessed with Space:1999, devours books and films, defies mom with petty rebellions. He never met his dad but watches him from afar, and learns that growing up ain't easy.

title: Show Me the Line
overview: Alabama Steel Magnolias chase and challenge the line where life begins in this tour de force through the heart of IVF healthcare.  When Alabama's Supreme Court declares embryos are legally children, reproductive justice journalist and IVF patient Abbey Crain begins a quest to honor the sanctity and personhood of Southern women through art. Reckoning with shame, grief, and marvel, she introduces a community stage for unheard stories of everyday Alabamians.

title: 2 Big to Rig
overview: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

title: Skin of Foam
overview: On a quiet night in the biggest city of Southern China, a small-town migrant carwash worker encounters a strange customer who forces him into a decision that might change his life.

title: Hibernation
overview: When an unemployed actor Pavle takes a job as an entertainer at a children's birthday party, an unexpected encounter with his former university classmates forces him to confront his own frustrations, face his failures, and in a surprising turn,  accept them.

title: Anchorage Point
overview: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

title: Vera
overview: A pregnant woman flees a violent past and takes refuge on the coast of Santa Fe, where she struggles to overcome the challenges of nature and existence itself.

title: Jakob & Anxiety
overview: Jacob, aged 22, navigates his way through everyday situations, constantly accompanied by Anxiety, an intrusive and manipulative presence that only he can see.  When Jacob is reunited with Mille, a girl from his past, he is forced to confront the voice that has controlled his life.  In a surreal inner journey where fantasy and reality merge, Jacob learns that anxiety cannot be eradicated—but it can be faced, named and lived with. The film blends realism, humour and visual metaphor to explore vulnerability, mental health and the courage it takes to let someone see who you really are.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: A horror story about keeping in touch with your high school friends.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: Fifth Mission
overview: A methodical hitman kills those he believes are beyond justice. When a detective whose brother he murdered begins to hunt him, the chase becomes personal, blurring the line between law, revenge, and morality, and asking how far justice can bend before it is justice no more?

title: Sutera Di Balik Purnama
overview: Melanie built a wall around her heart after the death of her fiancé, a loss that also shattered her faith in destiny. When her mother passed away and left a will instructing her to manage the traditional kebaya shop on Jonker Street, Melanie accepted it with a rebellious heart. Her plan was simple: destroy the business and walk away from everything.

title: Lumíria
overview: In the near future, three young people document the final days of their hometown, knowing they will never see it again.

title: Pass the Bottle
overview: A reckless addict is taken on an unexpected journey that forces her to fight for survival.

title: Hide
overview: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.

title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

title: Overlooked
overview: Overlooked follows Matt Iman as he returns home from a two-year LDS mission and begins navigating adulthood while living with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), a rare genetic condition that leaves his body unable to produce cortisol. Though he appears healthy, every day is shaped by medication, emergency preparedness, and the constant risk of a life threatening adrenal crisis. Through intimate observational storytelling, the film offers a deeply personal look at life with an invisible illness while exploring resilience, family, and the invisible realities of living with a rare disease.

title: Stamptown
overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

title: Nichts wie weg
overview: Nurse Anke Bender reacts decisively to inappropriate behavior. After a patient gropes her, she slaps him. Unfortunately, the patient turns out to be none other than Hamburg’s health senator, who dies the very next day following an incorrectly administered IV. To avoid arrest, Anke impulsively flees in an ambulance—unaware that the injured pianist Luise Dobertin is inside.

title: Pickleballers
overview: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.

title: Domeownation
overview: A cat performs a satanic ritual to dominate the world.

title: Lero Lero 1:1 | Ten Years of Experiencing Spaces
overview: Lero Lero, a student organization formed in 2015 at the School of Architecture and Urbanism and Design of USP, showcases a decade of work based in the idea that education extends beyond the classroom, seeking to connect students with architecture, urban planning, design and art projects at their actual scale.

title: The Eight Kings: Dragon Heist
overview: In the chaotic era of the Republic of China, Cheng Yang, the top master of the traditional Chinese trickster fraternity Qianmen, received his lover Ma Zhenzhen's death note and learned that the Nine-Dragon Sword had fallen into Warlord Zhang's hands. With no chance to seize it by force, Cheng Yang recalled the eight core members of Qianmen and used a series of eerie tricks, including ghost opera performers, bloody handprints, weeping Buddha statues, strange rice worm phenomena, and the Great Luo Golden Immortal ruse, to force Warlord Zhang to take out the sword himself.

title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
overview: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

title: Past, then... Future.
overview: An old man must come at peace with his past, only through painting will he achieve inner peace.

title: The Unknown
overview: Photographer David Zimmerman rarely leaves home until friends bring him to a wild party. He becomes fixated on a mysterious woman and follows her. By dawn, his life transforms - he awakens in her body.

title: The Meltdown
overview: 1992, Chile. Inés parents are away on business and she is left in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.

title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: The Penthouse
overview: The Penthouse" is a psychological thriller that follows Saina and David, a young family who moves into a luxurious penthouse in Kuala Lumpur to start a new life.

title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
overview: After struggling with his studies in the seminary, a young priest from Oklahoma discerns his call to serve Guatemala’s native people, no matter the cost. Hosted by Fr. Charles Connor.

title: The Last Sunrise
overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

title: Tarik
overview: After being expelled from school in Lazarevac, Tarik is forced to leave his single mother, Marija, and move to Novi Pazar to live with his father, Safet, and his family.

title: Sang Suraksha
overview: How difficult it is to find work in Indonesia, which means many people are forced to work to survive on minimal wages.

title: Betty
overview: Betty, an acclaimed, but washed-up painter, is commissioned to create an art piece for a prestigious museum. In order to regain the creative brilliance of the suffering artist, she isolates herself in a secluded house with one ambition: to induce depression.

title: Yellow Mirror
overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

title: Ghost Band
overview: After surviving the tragic car accident that claimed her parents when she was a child, Mita awakened to a strange gift — the ability to see and hear spirits. Now seventeen, she works part-time in a small musical instrument shop, where one fateful evening she stumbles upon an unusual band: a group of musician ghosts. What begins as a haunting encounter soon blossoms into an unlikely friendship, as Mita joins them in playing music that bridges the worlds of the living and the dead. Their performances, captured on video, explode across social media, drawing global attention for their unearthly brilliance. The sudden fame earns them a chance to compete to become one of the top six acts in a major K-Pop concert, but with opportunity comes peril — shadows close in, and Mita and her ghost friends must fight to protect her gift before it is stolen and twisted for darker purposes.

title: The Airport Chaplain
overview: At a bustling international airport, lost people seek missed connections, while others carry heavy personal baggage. Tobias Wallace shepherds them all. Scruffy and benevolent in his hi-vis “Chaplain”-printed vest and always on call, he’ll bend rules to help passengers and workers alike – that includes Asha, a young woman hiding in the prayer room whose murky history stirs Tobias’s own deeply buried traumas. Not everybody is a fan of his methods, however: ambitious new terminal manager Mira has liability nightmare Tobias marked for redundancy. But as crises appear everywhere – overworked baggage handlers, security breaches, families torn apart and grief-stricken relatives – maybe this infuriating chaplain could be Mira’s salvation.

title: Ang Pinakamasarap na Pares sa Balat ng Lupa
overview: Don and Mola are best friends who are always hungry, always together, and always messing things up. One day, Don finds out he’s sick and he has only 24 hours left to live.

title: Wayward 2nema
overview: Dax, Arthur and Alice continue to deal with the repercussions from the Camera's influence. While something sinister brews in the background

title: The Last Salute
overview: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
overview: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

title: Memento Mori
overview: A young man looks back on the moment he first met his girlfriend, remembering the small sparks that brought them together. He tells their story with warmth and tenderness, from a simple encounter to a love that grew naturally between them. For him, it\s a cherished memory he still carries closely.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: Larry
overview: Takeshi Murata and Christopher Rutledge continue their playful investigation of both the sharp-edged hyperrealism of commercial CGI and its oozing, anarchic breakdown in Larry, which propels its titular character—a droopy-eyed canine baller—through a series of increasingly bizarre and messy loops. Set to a soundtrack of maxed-out electronic rhythms, these vignettes form a ludic study in morphology and motion, as its pooch protagonist continually vaults, multiplies, gets buckets, and dissolves into digital goo.

title: Muito Prazer
overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

title: God Skin
overview: Win, takes a lethal gamble to fund his mother's medical treatment when Itt, an old friend, lures him into the Arena. In this brutal underground circuit, fighters are marked with "God Skin" tattoos to gain a ruthless edge.

title: I Want Your Sex
overview: When fresh-faced Elliot lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy, his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.

title: & Sons
overview: A world-renowned but reclusive novelist, believing he is about to die, summons his estranged sons to his home. But instead of seeking forgiveness for their shattered family, he tells them a wild and unbelievable secret that could rewrite their past.

title: Abode of Dawn
overview: In the middle of the Siberian Taiga, cut off from the outside world, a community of men and women has lived for three decades, led by the man they consider their guide: Vissarion, the self-proclaimed messiah.

title: The Dog Stars
overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

title: Wildcards
overview: A jury deliberating the case of Theodore Sterling, a privileged young man accused of sexual assault of a 20-something African-American woman. The prosecution is led by Assistant State Attorney James Jones, an overworked yet determined prosecutor, who faces off against Greg Sims, a veteran defense attorney with an unbroken 25-year winning streak.

title: Our Secret
overview: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

title: April X
overview: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
overview: A forbidden exorcism is livestreamed in Indonesia, awakening the legendary female spirit Kuntilanak. What begins as an online spectacle quickly turns deadly. In Taiwan, Mila watches the ritual—and becomes the curse’s first victim. Soon, mysterious deaths and violent possessions follow. When Yulan collapses and is found to have lost part of her soul, it becomes clear that this is not an isolated incident, but a transnational curse. Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

title: Um Olhar Inquieto: O Cinema de Jorge Bodanzky
Trial of Hein
overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

title: Hive
overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

title: Buddy
overview: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

title: Pa Pa Go
overview: Influencer Bunny struggles to stand out online when her ex-gangster father, Tian, is released from prison. Their reunion sparks conflict as he’s urged to rejoin the triad while she defends her career. Tian’s accidental viral fame fuels jealousy from his ambitious underling, triggering gang turmoil and exposing Bunny’s family ties. As her public image collapses, father and daughter must confront their past and choose between power, pride, and love—learning that redemption and understanding are the only way to truly move forward.

title: Operasi Pesta Copet
overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

title: Among Us
overview: There's an impostor among us

title: Moonzy: The Dark Side of the Moon
overview: Luntik, Kuzya and Vupsen and Pupsen build a spacecraft to find Luntik's missing dad and encounter adventures in the search.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Sentient
overview: An investigation into laboratory research on animals exposes a hidden world in which it’s not just the animals getting hurt. The story of Dr. Lisa Jones Engel, a primatologist turned animal welfare advocate, asks whether harming animals and ourselves in science’s name is justified

title: Chelot
overview: The story follows Haqqim, a special operations police officer, who is forced to become an informant for a crime syndicate to overcome financial pressure and save his family. This desperate act puts himself and his loved ones in danger.

title: Unisono
overview: When young musicians come together to play classical music, they send out a strong signal to our today’s world. The film follows talented young Swiss musicians as they work, search for inspiration, but also expose their thought how to play nowadays the “old” Classical music.

title: Buyer Beware
overview: A hilarious new horror story by upcoming director ‘Tommy Linguey’ - Coming Soon

title: Алмаз «Сердце Персии»
overview: The Cyrus the Great Diamond is stolen from an excavation site in Iran and falls into the hands of a Russian boy vacationing at the seaside with his family.

title: Fragments of Belonging
overview: Tatjana is lonely. Born in Croatia, she has lived across Europe before settling in Amsterdam. Fifteen years later, her teenage son avoids bringing friends home, embarrassed by her dreadful Slavic accent and her lack of Dutch composure. But the real trouble is bigger: Tatjana feels foreign everywhere. Determined to belong, she starts knocking on doors across Europe, asking relatives and friends how they did it. Stumbling through cultural misfires and everyday bias, she finally confronts a dark pattern in her own family history.

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: Mulher Papaya
overview: At nearly 70, Hilda's solitude shifts when a domestic accident and a caregiver’s touch awaken long-buried sensations, leading to a personal awakening.

title: Shark Thrash
overview: A small and touristy beachside town is hit by a storm the size of which nobody could have predicted. A family who just arrived tries to escape, but gets stuck in the quickly rising waters. They try to figure a way out with the help of some locals, but any progress is shut down when the sharks make their way onto the flooded streets. The family and locals must now find a way to survive as the waters rise.

title: Forever 16
overview: Charlotte, Helena, and Oskar haven't really been in touch since their experimental filmmaking group disbanded. A shared vacation aims to reunite the bitterly estranged trio, but envy and jealousy soon flare up again. Things get really complicated when Rudolph joins the group and they decide to make a film about a female serial killer.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

title: The Chilean
overview: 1976, Aldo, an explosives expert, is exiled to Italy after mining protests. There he meets Luciana, an anarchist doctor who offers to reunite him with his family, but only if he takes up his old trade: making bombs for revolutionaries.

title: Austerity
overview: Mona is a young woman and bookworm with no formal education, living in the social housing project Nøjsomheden in Helsingør. She falls head over heels in love with Nikolaj, who comes from a more well-off neighborhood on the other side of town. Meanwhile, she is also desperately trying to get her pusher cousin Frederik to realize that he must visit his dying mother, Mona's beloved and all-embracing Aunt Tut. Will Mona succeed in getting Frederik to reconcile with his mother - and how? Can she match the intellectual Nikolaj - or is the class gap too great?

title: Paket Santet
overview: A package arrives at their doorsteps. There is no sender's name. No explanation as to why it was delivered to them. But the moment they open it, their lives spiral into a nightmare. One by one, lives are put on the line. Now, the question is no longer how to avoid the package, but how to escape the curse once they have received it.

title: Rumah Singgah
overview: Karla, a talented young runner diagnosed with bone cancer, receives treatment at a halfway house. There, she learns to accept reality through the support of the residents and bu Andin, while together they realize their ultimate dream.

title: Nem Tudo é Paz e Amor
Train of Mist
overview: From inside the funicular heading to Harder Kulm, the landscapes in the foreground and background appear to shift at different speeds with the train’s motion. These vistas gradually accumulate, yielding various impressions.

title: MYXOMATOSIS
overview: Harlen’s a young  girl who curiously follows a pair of pink hands through a mirror.  She becomes part of a beautiful world where absolutely everything is controlled by The ominous Man with The Bunnyhead.

title: Marco Bellocchio - La porta della realtà
overview: After 20 years of working with Marco Bellocchio, a close collaborator feels the need to share what he experienced with him.

title: Lone wolf
overview: The docudrama Lone Wolf follows the life and combat experiences of RAF fighter pilot Josef František. Director Ondřej Veverka presents the story of a pilot who made his name whilst serving with the RAF’s 303rd Polish Fighter Squadron during the Battle of Britain. The film portrays Josef František not only as a flying ace with eighteen aerial victories during the Battle of Britain, but also as a man plagued by inner doubts yet possessing exceptional courage.

title: Weedkiller
overview: Weedkiller is a Welsh B-movie and indie SOV horror feature written and directed by filmmaker Tom Hughes. The film follows a humble gardener who goes on a violent rampage to rescue his beloved plants after a gang hijacks his allotment. The movie, described as a genre banger packed with chaos and attitude, draws inspiration from campy classics like The Toxic Avenger.

title: Liebe braucht Meer
overview: Lissi Strack, a young lawyer, travels with her mother Silvia, the owner of an internationally renowned law firm specializing in insolvency, to the Breton port city of Cancale. When Silvia has a mishap during the trip and is hit by a car driven by the young Alain Demur, she has no choice but to return home. This gives Lissi the chance to step in for Silvia, find an investor on her own, and finally prove herself to her mother.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
overview: See the premiere of an extended look at Grand Theft Auto VI, the next evolution in the groundbreaking Grand Theft Auto series.

title: The man who can't sleep
overview: Kept awake by an unbearably loud punk concert, a man's frustration mounts as his deaf girlfriend struggles to understand why he’s making such a fuss.

title: Solidarité Incendies - Le Grand Concert en direct
Papi Ricky: La Película
overview: Alicia returns to Chile to introduce her future husband, an eccentric young Spanish hipster who embodies modernity. His arrival causes a family upheaval, and the clash with the conservative Papi Ricky and the irreverent Catrala leads both parents to put aside their old differences and unite around a common goal: stopping their daughter’s wedding.

title: Rotten
overview: A woman living with the pain of a rotten tooth plans to spend savings on a dentist appointment. But an unexpected afternoon with her boss's wife draws her into a world she cannot afford.

title: Listen, Mom
overview: A grieving playwright returns to his rural hometown to come out to his traditional mother following the sudden death of his partner. Their painful confrontation and the unspoken truths that come to light become the catalyst for him to find his creative voice again.

title: Myth Schalke - A life long
overview: Mythos Schalke tells the story of the 2025/26 season, spanning the battle in the second division to FC Schalke 04's return to the Bundesliga.

title: April 30th
overview: Two dates in one night rarely made Victoria blink. Tonight, she should have kept her eyes wide open.

title: La Primera Vez
overview: Nerves, lost condoms, and a maze of identical houses—Javier’s first time with Michel turns into a gauntlet of masculinity, where every stranger he meets holds up a mirror to what it means to be a man. A shy delivery driver, a grieving lover, and a jacked provocateur all test him, but the real question is whether he is going to make it back to Michel’s.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Last Night I Conquered the City of Thebes
overview: On a cold winter afternoon, António and Jota return from the front with their friends, looking for an ancient Roman thermal bath. They joke with each other while wading through swamps, recounting past tactical glories. The baths have appeared after a long time spent under the water of a reservoir, and people of all ages curious about the discovery come to spend the day. But there is something mysterious about these thermal waters - as if the baths influence the mood of the men, giving them the courage to say things they have never told anyone. As day turns to night, they confess their feelings and their fears of losing their best friend forever.

title: The Whisper Man
overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

title: Hi!
overview: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

title: Once More
overview: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
overview: Upcoming Kannada Film

title: Lust
overview: Professor Michael Meloun arrives in Belgrade as a visiting lecturer. He suffers a panic attack, and doctors find out his agoraphobia has worsened. He must stay indoors. Maria, whom he meets at the hospital, stays to care for him.

title: Maya Satya Bhram
overview: A sub-inspector's eight year-old son goes missing. A researcher in Sweden is disappeared after seven months. Are they connected?

title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Retribution
overview: Tate battles ruthless mercenaries throughout Ibiza as he avenges his friend's death.  Get ready for the biggest and most action packed film in the successful independent crime saga.

title: Dead End
overview: Located in a futuristic Dhaka City from the 2100s. We follow Zayn Khan our protagonist, a genius engineer trying to fulfill his father's dream. However, he gets intertwined with a street racing gang named 'The Hawks', lead by Alvan Haque.

title: The Brightest Sun
overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Beyond Belief
overview: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

title: The Ghost and The Gun
overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
overview: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

title: The Pickleball Racket
overview: Disgraced councilwoman of Busterville, Ethel Wilton, finds herself at the center of a pickleball conspiracy. She decides the only way to save her city is to stop the citywide pickleball tournament with the help of her unlikely friends.

title: The Last Scene
overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

title: I Don't Know You
overview: An emotional drama about teenage Asako and her relationship with Yuhei, a man who became a father figure to her for six months when she was five years old after he started dating her mother. Thirteen years later, she discovers he is serving a prison sentence, having been convicted of her mother’s murder.

title: Goodbye Girl
overview: Jess is a professional heartbreaker. Literally. When she’s hired by a cowardly bride to dump her groom days before their wedding, she not only fumbles the job… but falls hopelessly in love.

title: The Secret Woman
overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

title: Heavy
overview: A man cleans up a murder.

title: Baggo
overview: Directed by Baljit Singh Deo

title: The Invisibles
overview: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: Lives at Right Angles
overview: Daiki has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother at a young age, the siblings distanced themselves from their neglectful father and have lived their lives diligently together

title: Babita Singh Reporting
overview: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

title: Woollen sock
overview: Woollen sock joins in a loud concert with pots and pans, but can woollen sock ever be heard by others?

title: My Playground
overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

title: Starsuckers
overview: A celebrity couple invite two of their biggest fans for a weekend escape, with each duo harbouring an ulterior motive.

title: Ebre / Trarza
overview: This short documentary addresses the global issue of climate change, highlighting its unequal impacts on rural communities in deltaic regions of both the Global South and North. While the Global North is a major contributor to climate change, its devastating effects are most felt in the Global South, particularly in regions like Trarza, Mauritania, where agriculture is severely impacted. Similarly, the Terres de l’Ebre in Catalonia faces rising sea levels and land erosion, threatening local livelihoods. These shared challenges provide a rich opportunity for youth from both regions to engage in dialogue and storytelling.

title: Top of the World
overview: Explores Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant that occupied the 106th and 107th floors of the North Tower of the World Trade Center.

title: Parbati
overview: Autism is not a weakness or a flaw, it is simply a different way of experiencing the world. Every person learns, thinks, feels, communicates, and understands life in their own unique way. This story follows the emotional journey of a brother and sister whose deep bond becomes the heart of the film. Amid society’s misunderstandings and everyday struggles, their relationship reflects love, acceptance, sacrifice, and the strength of family, creating a touching and inspiring tale about embracing individuality.

title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
overview: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

title: Rent in Peace
overview: When a desperate yet lousy landlord drags one of his tenants to evict another tenant from a long-abandoned house he had acquired as a property, the mission turns into a nightmare neither of them can escape.

title: The Parking Spot
overview: A quarrel over a parking space pulls a couple into an unexpected confrontation with a stranger.

title: Romin
overview: When Romin discovers a lost object in the forest, he asks his friends to help him uncover the legend behind this mysterious object, while a grieving man seeks to use the artifact to bring his wife back.

title: The Essentials 2
overview: After traveling to the past and interrupting the plans of the villains Pals, Kanjuan and Walten finally live their well-deserved vacation but this is interrupted after revealing a new villain: Hyday the god of time, who will try to interrupt their plans, so Elisa, April, Elias, Julef join together to challenge Hyday.

title: One Of You Will Betray Me
overview: After her secret is shared outside of her friend group, Meghan has to figure out which one of her friend's betrayed her trust.

title: Flaggan
overview: On election night 2010, two young Sweden Democrats — the charming but unserious Ville and his cousin Tobias — are given the task of hanging a huge Swedish flag in Rinkeby square, but end up drawn into a chaotic night full of crazy encounters with drug dealers, activists, and Finnish bikers.

title: Crimson High
overview: When a human girl transfers to a prestigious academy for monsters and humans, she falls for a brooding vampire student, only to discover their love is the key to unlocking a dormant supernatural war.

title: Hay una canción de Taylor Swift para todo
In Tania's Head
overview: Tania Head became a household name as a 9/11 survivor, celebrated for her miraculous escape from the very floor the plane hit. Her story of resilience, coupled with the heartbreaking death of her fiancé, Dave, moved the nation. As president of the Survivors' Network, she was a symbol of American strength, a fixture alongside political elites at Ground Zero. The illusion shattered in 2007 when a New York Times investigation proved her story was a lie: her career, her fiancé, even her identity.

title: Junction Row
overview: Juno is a recovering addict who leaves a fringe housing compound for a better life, leaving her beloved Ruby behind. When she learns that Ruby has gone missing, Juno returns, only to find Junction Row has become a hotbed of criminal activity, but she encounters much more than menacing drug dealers on her mission to find Ruby.

title: Masterni
overview: A girl goes missing, leaving the nation in shock as every lead goes cold.

title: Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger Film Concert in Cinema
overview: A recording of the Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger Film Concert, which was held in May 2025. Experience the show's iconic score and the final battle with live orchestral music performed by the Grand Philharmonic TOKYO!

title: Electric Meat
overview: A photographer spirals into madness when a murdered model he's adopted as his new muse decides she doesn't want to stay dead.

title: King KOSOKO
overview: Warrior Kosoko, grandson of King Ologun Kutere, survives childhood curses to become a formidable prince. When his father, Esinlokun, dies, Kosoko is sidelined as his younger brother Idewu and later his uncle Adele Ajosun usurp the throne. Kosoko bides his time, amassing wealth through trade and alliances.

title: The Wrong Housemaid
overview: After vanishing from her violent husband's grasp ten years ago, Mona thought she had finally secured a peaceful new life for herself and her teenage daughter, Denise, behind carefully crafted new identities. But their fragile safety shatters when a seemingly harmless housemaid enters their home and begins manipulating their lives with chilling precision.

title: Amyl and the Sniffers Present: Truth Or Consequence
overview: Truth or Consequence is a concert film in which Amyl and The Sniffers perform country-influenced versions of their songs, two unreleased tracks, and a cover of the Slim Dusty classic 'Lights On The Hill'. It was recorded and filmed in front of an intimate and increasingly rowdy audience at El Coyote in Los Angeles, by the band's long-time collaborator, John Angus Stewart.

title: The King of Cannabis
