overview: Inspired by true events, this crime drama follows the rise of Terrence "Tee" Jackson as he builds a drug empire.

title: 2 Murders in September
overview: A killer records himself opening the body of one of his victims, two murders happen.

title: Extraordinary
overview: Nora (75), a forgotten superheroine, faces her daughter's decision to place her in a nursing home. Before losing her independence, she embarks on one final mission to regain lost recognition and prove that she can still choose her own destiny.

title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

title: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
overview: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

title: Dress-Up
overview: A young couple, Charlie and Steph, both realize they're trans after having sex while wearing gender-swapped Halloween costumes. Charlie comes to terms with it faster than Steph, causing unexpected friction in their relationship.

title: Corsu Mezu Mezu - Un soir au Vélodrome avec Patrick Fiori
Tom & Cherry
overview: When Tom suddenly disappears, a mysterious man named Cheer becomes part of an extraordinary journey that no one sees coming. Packed with laughter, emotions, unexpected twists, and heartwarming moments, Tom and Cherry is a wholesome family entertainer that celebrates the true meaning of love and togetherness.

title: The Back of the Barn
overview: Isolated on his family farm, Peter must reveal the secret that lies in the back of the barn.

title: Mr. Lavender
overview: Set in 1950, this espionage thriller focuses on Peter Denton, a closeted KGB spy working undercover in the U.S. State department, as he strives to keep his carnal affair with his KGB handler hidden. When a top secret FBI task force abducts him for questioning, Peter must decide to bluff or fold

title: Echo Point
overview: A man inherits a secluded cabin from his estranged father. Inside, he discovers an old radio emitting strange, eerie signals. As he begins to unravel the truth, he realises the voices on the other end belong to the victims of a killer.

title: Call My Agent! The Movie
overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

title: BETTER WITH MILK
overview: In 1947, in an upscale neighborhood of Brighton, Parvati has been working as a maid for Victoria since arriving from India six years earlier. Her encounter with Preethi, the neighbor's new maid, awakens buried memories, transporting her back to her native country despite herself.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Violent Delight
overview: A lonely artist draws her perfect companion-but the more he sees her, the more she loses herself.

title: 13 Souls
overview: Following her mother’s death, fifteen-year-old Agne moves in with her estranged father and older sister near a cemetery where he works. There, she uncovers a mysterious and deadly connection between her family and the “13 Souls” — victims of a tragic, unsolved fire decades earlier. As the past resurfaces and strange phenomena escalate, Agne finds herself entangled in a supernatural mystery tied to possession, reincarnation, and long-buried guilt.

title: Much About Love
overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

title: Ashamed
overview: Before his childhood best friend leaves for good, a closeted married man has one last chance to show the truth — or stay trapped in a life that was never really his.

title: Little High
overview: A heartbreak comedy about female friendship, accidental kidnapping, and a TikToking police officer set across one bright, terrible Nairobi afternoon.

title: Now and Then
overview: A college student, along with her peers in Japan, rally to change the country’s hostile immigration laws that have incarcerated asylum-seekers in deadly detention centers. Meanwhile, over a century since the 1923 massacre of Korean people during a massive earthquake in Imperial Japan, young activists today take on the torch to seek justice under a government that continues to deny this history. A filmmaker documenting these young activists on the ground begins to excavate the underlying history of discrimination that connects the massacre of a hundred years ago and the draconian refugee system in Japan. Through the process of listening to voices from the past and present, the landscapes in Tokyo begin to echo the unfinished business of the nation’s reckoning with its colonial history.

title: Binding Eva
overview: Deep in an English forest, a man on the run returns again and again to the same moment of judgement, and the same impossible choice.

title: LEATHERBACK
overview: In 1994, a college film crew began documenting two promising physics students, Yulon Ackster and Anthony Schmitt, as they claimed to have cracked the code of controlling time itself. The project was expunged following a terrorist attack in Melbourne, Florida. This is the unsealed footage of what they found.

title: Heraldry Paranormal
overview: Four paranormal investigators want to find definitive proof of ghosts within Yorkshire, but find themselves at odds with conmen, internet backlash, and terror beyond their expectations.

title: The Brook
overview: Moving to the village of his mother’s youth, art student Jacob discovers his grandad’s old video camera shows one hour into the past. In Elmbrook, a place steeped in strange folklore and whispered legends, the community believe their village is protected by a puma that watches over the “good.” But when one of the good locals mysteriously vanishes, Jacob and his friends, armed with the video camera, uncover clues that pull them deeper into Elmbrook’s bizarre secrets. Soon the search for answers spirals into a dangerous mystery as they uncover a vengeful serial killer with a connection to the past.

title: The Hoarder
overview: Medical student Melissa Knowles and her reluctant colleague Eric are making routine house calls to administer flu vaccines. When they step into Fred Hunt’s decaying, junk-crammed home, something immediately feels wrong. Fred seems like a harmless old recluse, but when Eric vanishes, Melissa’s search pulls her deeper into the house’s chaotic mess, revealing a labyrinth of tunnels carved through the piles of junk, twisting into suffocating darkness. And beneath it all, below the creaking floorboards, something stirs. Watching. Waiting.

title: Dulce Violencia (aka Sweet Violence)
overview: A family plans to murder their daughter’s killer after he is released from a twenty-year prison sentence. Still pleading innocence, the ex-convict tries to rebuild his life until the ghosts of the past return to haunt him

title: The Copycat Killer
overview: A traumatized criminal profiler is lured in to investigate a copycat killer mimicking her most infamous case while being framed as the prime suspect, or risk losing her freedom and becoming the next victim of a twisted game of revenge.

title: Okay? Alright.
overview: A reclusive Filipino-Korean man travels back in time to kill his pregnant mother in hopes of ceasing to exist. But in doing so, he obtains a certain hope that his life will turn out okay.

title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

title: Will Revenge
overview: On what begins as a quiet night at home, four friends are confronted with the news of a devastating act of anti-trans violence. In an instant, their sense of safety is shattered. As shock gives way to grief—and grief to rage—their quiet evening fractures into a shared, unspoken question: what does justice look like when the world refuses to provide it?

title: BLOODSUCKER
overview: A vampire hunter clashes with his prey.

title: Meurtres à Fontainebleau
overview: When a murder revives the legend of the "Grand Veneur", the forest of Fontainebleau becomes the hunting ground of an elusive killer.

title: El veneno del pueblo
overview: Seventy-six-year-old Elvira lives alone, finding comfort in the glow of her television. When news of a cockroach infestation sparks panic, she turns her home into a fortress of insecticide. But as a strange, viscous substance begins to thrive on the poison, the boundary between the infestation and Elvira’s own decay starts to blur.

title: The American Teacher
overview: At an elite private school for the ultra-wealthy, an innocent new American teacher is caught between two rival high school girls vying for his favor and the prom queen's crown, only for a hidden and scandalous relationship to come to light.

title: Magic 8
overview: 1974. A Smoke filled Sports Bar. Love is like a game of pool. “Magic 8” is a 3 minute short film shot on Super 8, which explores what happens when making a queer connection in a stereotypically “Straight” space. It follows two men (referred to as Solid and Stripe), who engage in a game of 8-Ball Pool. As an audience we get the impression this is a regular occurrence for our two characters, but there is a mutual understanding that none of Solid’s inner dialogue could ever be said out loud.

title: Fire & Ice
overview: A musical western.

title: An Esker in the Sun
overview: A short documentary about the environmental art exhibition Oranki Art, set in the northern wilderness. People arrive, depart and age, while the artworks remain and decay. The film lingers on the moments when new works are born and become part of the seemingly eternal landscape.

title: Outflow
overview: A woman in emotional crisis embarks on an introspective journey in search of relief and transformation.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Oradour
overview: Five days before the massacre at Oradour-sur-Glane , Philippe Gerbier, an officer in the Free French Forces , is parachuted in near the village . He is to lead a mission for the Resistance in preparation for the D-Day landings . There, he is reunited with Marie, his childhood sweetheart.

title: AEW All In: London
overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: Why Religion?
overview: "Why Religion?" is a feature-length documentary film exploring the extraordinary work and personal journey of renowned scholar Elaine Pagels. Celebrated for her groundbreaking research on the Gnostic Gospels, Pagels challenges conventional religious narratives and invites us to rethink how early western religions approached divinity, enlightenment, and the human experience. The film offers intimate access to her life and work, revealing how her research of ancient texts shaped her own path of spirituality and self-discovery.

title: Other People
overview: Su is a loner, relying on Anti-Depressants and Benzo, waiting for gas during the gas shortage caused by Iran and American Conflict. Then came her longtime friend Than Dar, and her boyfriend Nay Gyi.

title: Alien Heart
overview: Miles and Ravi house sit a NASA exobiologist mansion, while running astronomy club sign ups, they discover a runaway alien on a ticking cosmic clock, bullies, and crushes that turn their summer into chaos and adventure.

title: Vape Glow
overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

title: Same As It Ever Was
overview: When two gunmen come for Justin Johnson, he needs to choose between casual Fridays or the things that are once in a lifetime.

title: The Robot Chicken [adult swim] 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Follows iconic Adult Swim characters on a cruise ship celebrating the network's 25th anniversary. The cruise turns into a disaster, potentially spelling a watery doom for all aboard.

title: Ādi
overview: "Ādi" (Sanskrit for "beginning" or "origin) captures the origin of the cross-cultural musical group Vishnu, Davis, & Haleigh as they discover new friendships and new sounds together.

title: Her Baby Didn't Block Her Jump Shot
overview: In 1969, high school freshman Jane led her basketball team to a state tournament. In 1970, she scored over 40 points a game. In 1971, when she gives birth, state rules make her ineligible to play. In 1972, with the backing of her coach and friends, she continued to play and began a landmark challenge to a rule that allowed boys involved in a pregnancy to continue playing while refusing the same privilege to girls.

title: Plonternish
overview: Eli writes a play.

title: Motka
overview: In the improvised café “Radi Motka” in Dorćol, run and informally legalized by the resourceful Srboljub Dudić Srba, a diverse group of locals gathers: Žarko Zrenjanin, Vlada, Bane, Professor, Father Laza, Panja Panić, and Sloba. After a failed eviction, Sloba becomes the target of a media lynching, so the group organizes an improvised trial. This gives birth to SAČ – the Serbian Anti-Thief Squad. Encouraged by their initial success, SAČ members escalate their actions—from kidnapping Živaljević to hunting a dog poisoner—but the line between justice and lawlessness begins to blur. When they discover the poisoner is one of their own, the group falls apart and personal issues come to the surface. Forced to face the consequences of their actions, they manage to find a partial sense of peace, while “Radi Motka” survives as a symbol of their struggle and flawed attempts at justice.

title: Inheritor
overview: On the day of her ascension within her secluded, tree-worshiping cult, Ama, a sheltered young woman, leaps into a treacherous psychedelic ritual that faces her with a choice between her duty to her people and her desire to be with her childhood best friend and lover, Oakley.

title: Kuru' Sumange'
overview: In a small town in the Bugis region, seven children from diverse backgrounds are brought together for a Regional Children's Festival. Aisyah, a lonely girl, meets fellow participants who are each grappling with their own personal struggles. The judges group them together to stage a top-notch performance, and a variety of conflicts arise, challenging them to keep the show going in the name of friendship.

title: Remembering Dolly: A Rhinestone Life
overview: Hosted by Entertainment Tonight co-hosts Kevin Frazier and Nischelle Turner, the special looks back at Parton’s journey from the Smoky Mountains to international stardom.

title: Fear The Lamb
overview: The Son of Man has suffered, been rejected by the elders, chief priests, and teachers of the law, been killed, and rose after three days. This is good news to the world, but it is not good news to everyone, for the father of lies has just received word that the tomb is empty, and that death has no power over the sinless Son of god. The Deceiver goes to find out if this is true and what that would mean for what he's dedicated his existence to.

title: Den Umulige Balance Mellem Os og Dig
Traces
overview: In a dystopian Ireland, a grieving widower strives to recover what was lost, an AI wrestles with a new found conscience, and a dark secret looms high on the horizon.

title: Claire McKenna
overview: After years of addiction and isolation, Claire McKenna is finally home from rehab. It’s her first day back—and her first day of probation.  Anxiously awaiting her parole officer, Claire discovers something from her old life that suddenly puts her fragile new beginning into question.  To everyone around her, the moment may seem insignificant. For Claire, it’s a fierce and deeply personal battle to remain sober, honest, and alive.

title: Zip Wire
overview: When her ground-breaking pharmaceutical discovery is stolen and partner murdered, researcher Amy must face her fear of heights to escape nefarious attackers, with the only path to salvation being a treacherous aerial runway. To outsmart the mysterious hostiles, she has to summon every ounce of courage to protect the world-changing scientific discovery — and herself — before it's too late.

title: Full Moon Rising: The Charles Band Story
overview: A brand new feature documentary about the incredible life and career of prolific film producer and director Charles Band.

title: Brandon & Haider
overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Salut Dad
overview: A short film about grief/ai.

title: Couches & Chairs
overview: Two best friends set out to summon demons and it goes horribly wrong. They spend the remainder of the night searching for what is real and what isn't.

title: The Blue Hour
overview: When a shadow emerges from the past, his last chance of survival might also be his enemy.

title: Soul Snatchers
overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Valley View Motel
overview: After a 1977 diamond heist goes sideways, two small-time crooks take refuge at a remote Pennsylvania motel, where a pair of bizarre sibling owners, a ruthless hitman and a night full of bad decisions turn their getaway into a desperate fight to survive the night and make it to their rendezvous before it's too late.

title: Bloom
overview: When Lily inherits her great aunt's struggling desert nursery, she devotes herself to bringing it back to life. As her garden flourishes, her need to sustain it becomes something she can no longer control.

title: NXT Heatwave 2026
overview: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

title: AAA Ola de Calor 2026
overview: Ola de Calor 2026 (Spanish for "Heat Wave") was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue.

title: Cockroaches
overview: Three porch pirates steal a van and find the kidnapped Queen of Belgium in the back. Low-rent larceny spirals into a disaster worth remembering and mutual regret might be mistaken for something deeper. Probably not, but maybe.

title: Shadow Realm
overview: While Detectives Eisler and Komlatschek fear for Oberländer's life, they uncover a bloody trail of revenge that leads them to an abandoned juvenile home deep in the woods.

title: The Gambit
overview: Tony, a middle-aged man, is sitting at a table with a chessboard setup. Brent, in his early twenties, walks into the cafe and takes a seat across from Tony. They play a game of chess while they talk about business, through the lens of chess. Tony is clearly a veteran that has been playing a long time, and knows his way around the board. Brent is new to the game, but has a creativity and strategy that Tony can’t read.

title: Loinnir
overview: Filmed on vacation with dear friends on Magheraclogher Beach near the village of Bunbeg and on Tory Island, both in Ireland. An excerpt from the longer work in-progress, 'Self Portrait at 34'. Two rolls of 16mm, edited in-camera. Shot on 50D and Ektachrome. 'Loinnir' is an Irish word which means " faint or veiled and tremulous gleam or shining; a glimmer", referring simultaneously to light reflected on the waves and the warm internal feeling which stems from quality time spent with friends. The camera shutter decided to add to the feeling on this occasion. Éirinn go Brách!
